Skating.name: 2 Line Powerskating Cone to Cone
Skating.description: 2 line powerskating cone to cone. Once players get to the cone they stay there.

Skating.name: 3 Large Circles
Skating.description: Run 3 players at a time 1. Players skate three slow, powerful circles, using up as much space in each zone as possible 2. Focus on staying low, with strong, rhythmic stride 3. Technique should mimic "short track speed skating"

Skating.name: 60 Second Drill
Skating.description: 1. Divide team into two groups 2. Players skate a ladder as shown - make sure each stop is facing the same direction. (5 push-ups per infraction) 3. Run it on a stop watch, if anyone in the group doesn't make it under 60 seconds, the group goes again, this time they have to make it under 65 seconds. Keep adding 5 seconds, and making them go again until everyone ﬁnishes within the time limit Variation: Lower time to 55 seconds; add pucks; make defensemen skate backward; make defensemen face up ice the entire drill.

Skating.name: Agility Circuit
Skating.description: 1. Players start in opposite corners 2. Line 1 does quick, side-step crossovers, 5 steps at a time to the top of the circle, then explodes into full-speed 5 step crossovers (drive skating) through the neutral zone and gets in the back of line 2 3. Line 2 does power turns and pivots through the cones as shown Note: Drill can be done with or without pucks

Skating.name: Agility Passing
Skating.description: 1. Player 1 starts with a puck and skates around the circle. 2. 1 passes to 3, gets a pass back 3. 1 passes to 2 and gets a pass back. 4. When 1 reaches the goal line, he/she pivots backwards and returns around the circle passing to both 2 and 3 on the way back.

Skating.name: Burkett Agility Conditioning
Skating.description: Run 3 or 4 groups. 5 push-ups after each stop. Next group leaves when group ahead gets to far blue line. After the last group ﬁnishes, repeat the same thing coming back. Use the following sequence or make up your own: 1. Sprint to far end. 2. Sprint to far end using 5-step crossovers. 3. Sprint to far end, dropping to right knee at the blue line, left knee at the red line, both knees at the far blue line. 4. Sprint to far end, superman dives on each blue. 5. Sprint to far end, barrel roles on each blue. 6. Sprint to far end, high tuck jumps over the blues. 7. Sprint to end boards and back.

Skating.name: Christmas Tree Conditioning
Skating.description: 1. Players line up in the corners 2. On whistle, a player from each corner skates the pattern as shown. 3. Drill is to be executed at full speed Variations: Add pucks; pivot from forward to backward; etc.

Skating.name: Circle Agility Drill
Skating.description: 1. Player starts on the face off dot. 2. On the whistle he explodes to the edge of the circle, pivots and skates backward along the LEFT side of the circle to about the middle of the circle, and stops. 3. Player then skates forward along the same edge of the circle until he comes back to the top of the circle again, then pivots and skates backward to the dot, and stops. 4. Player executes side-step-crossovers to the left edge of the circle, stops, side-step- crossovers all the way back across to the far right edge of the circle, stops, then side- step-crossovers back to the dot, and stops. 5. Player again explodes to the top of the circle, pivots and skates backward along the RIGHT side of the circle to about the middle of the circle, and stops. 6. Player then skates forward along the same edge of the circle until he comes back to the top of the circle again, then pivots and skates backward all the way to the bottom edge of the circle. Notes: Try putting 3-4 players per circle, and rotate through until each player has completed the drill 3 times. As players' skating skills improve, add a puck.

Skating.name: D - Agility Breakaway Pass

Skating.name: Drill 2: Forward vs Backwards race.
Skating.description: Explanation Line 1 is behind the blue line. Line 2 is at center ice. 2 must start backwards. Players will race to the top of the circles on the opposite end. Once completed, players will hook to the opposite wall and come back to the opposite line.

Skating.name: Drill 3: Sprints
Skating.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: On coaches whistle 1 and 2 will start on the edge of the circle. The players must hook and touch the blue line and turn to the near wall for their side. Players will hook around the dot. The drill is a race through the center ice line.

Skating.name: Figure 8 Angling
Skating.description: 1. Players start facing each other on dot 2. Forward skates around the high cone, picks up a puck and drives wide 3. Defenseman skates backward around bottom cone, pivots forward, then skates around middle cone and angles 4. Forward has to drive around lower cone before cutting to the net Variations: (a) take out the cone at hashmarks (b) allow forward to cut inside earlier

Skating.description: Four groups, on blues, facing each other. As soon as group 1 ﬁnishes, group 2 goes. Battling.name: 3 on 3 Angle
Battling.description: 1. 3 forwards swing low then attempt a breakout 2. 3 forechecking forwards angle 3. If forecheckers force a turnover before the blue line, they can attack 4. If turnover happens after the blue line, give it to the defensemen for a quick D-to-D pass 5. If forwards successfully breakout, they can attack

Battling.name: Angle Checking
Battling.description: 1. Players line up behind the net, as shown 2. First player in line skates the puck up the boards 3. Forechecker angles, squeezes him off, makes the hit, then passes back to the coach 4. Player who just took the hit becomes the new forechecker going the other way 5. New puck carrier can't leave until the forechecker passes coach

Battling.name: ANGLE PROGRESSION
Battling.description: 31 KEY POINTS: • Wide angle, matching Forwards speed • Stick placement, taking away the middle of the ice until last second, then stick on puck DESCRIPTION *Start drill at half speed and progress to full 1. F drives along boards and takes the wide lane to the net 2. D takes wide angle and holds stick on the board side at all times, cutting off the middle lane 3. D goes stick on puck when the F has been completely closed off

Battling.name: Around the Line
Battling.description: 1. Option 1 - player starts with a puck, skates around the cone. Second player in line backchecks, only has to go around the line. 2. Option 2 - player starts without a puck, skates around the cone. receives a pass from the line. Second player in line backchecks, only has to go around the line.

Battling.name: Chip & Chase Angling
Battling.description: 1. One player starts in front of the net and swings through to pick up a chip pass from the ﬁrst player in line 2. After picking up the puck, he carries it up around the far cone, then drives to the net for a scoring attempt 3. The player who made the chip pass skates around the middle cone as shown, then backchecks, angling the puck carrier to the boards 4. Backcheck becomes the new receiver on the chip pass, drill repeats

Battling.name: Full Ice Angling
Battling.description: In the diagram, blue goes against blue, white against white. 1. On whistle, the ﬁrst player from each corner line skates full speed down the boards, with a puck 2. First player from each NZ line leaves and skates the route shown, attempting to cut off the puck carrier's lane to the net, at or before the far blue line 3. If the puck carrier makes it to the blue line, he or she can cut to the net Notes: start with a rule that the puck carrier can't cut inside until after the blue line. As players improve, remove that rule.

Battling.name: Hashmark Angling
Battling.description: 1. One offensive player and one defensive player line up on each side of the hash marks 2. Coach dumps puck in the corner 3. Offensive player must go around low cone, get the puck, and attack the net 4. Defensive player must go around high cone, angle player, and ﬁnish check 5. Stagger the starts and run two lines simultaneously

Battling.name: PK Forecheck Angling
Battling.description: 1. Breakout man skates in, and opens up to either side for a breakout pass from the coach 2. F1 and F2 angle to take away the skating lane and passing lanes, respectively 3. If F1 and F2 fail to eliminate the breakout, the breakout man passes to the NZ coach for a give and go, and a shot on net Note: This drill can be run as a 2/3 ice drill by eliminating the option for a shot on goal. Play would end with the pass back to the NZ coach

Battling.name: Stanley Angle
Battling.description: 1. One player starts behind each net 2. Other players are on blue lines, ready to angle 3. On whistle, puck carrier drives up the boards 4. Player on close blue line angles and hits before the blue line 5. Puck carrier continues, and player from far blue line angles and hits before the next blue line 6. Puck carrier continues and takes a shot

The player with the puck skates to the dot and passes it across the ice to the other player who take it towards the net in the same end and takes the shot. After the initial pass... that player heads to the other end and acts as a rebound chaser. The shooter takes low hard shots enticing rebounds for BOTH players to react upon! Shooting.name: 6 Man Shooting
Shooting.description: 1. 6 lines of players set up on the hash marks and on the boards in line with the neutral zone dots, as shown. 2. On the whistle, the ﬁrst players from all 6 lines go (in the same direction) 3. Each player skates a "square" around the 4 dots closest to him or her, full speed, using crossovers 4. After rounding the ﬁnal turn, each player should explode to the net, and shoot in stride from the top of the circle

Shooting.name: Calgary Defense Drill
Shooting.description: 1. First D in line skates up and around the cone, pivots backward, then turns and picks up dumped in puck in the corner 2. After receiving the breakout pass, ﬁrst D passes up to the blue line defenseman again, who drag skates across for a second shot on net, then joins line of defensemen 5. First defenseman becomes blue line defenseman

Shooting.name: Continuous alternate (retrieve around the dots angle shots) - 10 mins
Shooting.description: This is a continuous drill started with a whistle. Pucks are placed loosely in the neutral zone. Players line up at the blue lines against the boards. (4 lines) Opposites adjacent players go along the blue line toward the middle then turn into the neutral zone, retrieve a puck. Continue with the puck around the near face off dot (completing a 360 degree turn) going in on an angle and shooting. The other players go once the shot is taken. (always alternating sides. Slow frequency allowing the goalies time to re- set and get across the net to cover their angles KeKey Points: Retrieve the puck with 2 hands on your stick keeping puck protection in mind. minimize skating cross overs (do tight turns) Make sure the shot is taken before the next player goes

Shooting.name: Continuous soft dump cycle with 2 options - 10 mins
Shooting.description: Offensive cycle drill with 2 variations. Option A- Up the boards Starting in the middle of the ice at the blue line, Player 1 (blue) softly dumps the puck into the right side corner and proceeds to go and retrieve it and skate with the puck up the boards. Then drop passes the puck (off the boards at the hash marks is best) to the supporting player 2 (green) following the same route coming in to pick up the cycle pass. After the drop pass, player 1 (blue) continues over and around the face off circle (with their stick on the ice) ready to receive the puck back from player 2 (green) then passes back to player 1 (blue) who takes a shot and goes back to the line. Immediately after, player 2 (green) sets up the shot, skates directly into the other (left) corner to keep the drill continuous. The next player in the line softly dumps a puck into the corner and follows in support to keep the drill going the other way/side. Option B- Reverse cycle. Player 1 (green) softly dumps into the right side corner proceeds to retrieve the puck and skates up the boards with the puck. Drop passes the puck off the boards at the hash marks and continues over top and around the face off circle ready to receive the puck back from player 2 (blue). Player 2 (blue) skates to the boards (same side right side) and heads down the wall retrieves the puck skating under the goal line towards the net and passes the puck back to Player 1 (green) Player 1 (green) takes the shot and goes back into line. Player 2 (after the pass) immediately goes to the other side corner to retrieve the softly dumped puck to continue the drill going the other way. y Points Timing + cycle passes using the boards A ) Up the boards B ) reverse and down

Shooting.name: Continuous swings with angle passes - 10 mins
Shooting.description:
Whistle to start the drill. Players start with a puck at the top of the face off circles, go in and take a shot. Immediately continue into the corner to retrieve a puck. The remaining players in their lines (1 at theblue line boards and 2 at the center ice face off circle) with timing swing low in support ready to receive a pass. The players at the blue line boards, swing low into the middle. The players at the center ice face off circle swing low towards the boards. After the shot and retrieval, 2 passes are made to the swinging players moving the puck up the ice to keep the drill continuous and rotating. The yellow lines indicate where to go after the passes are made.

Key Points: Deep support stick on the ice. Angle passes. Timing + positioning

Stickhandling.name: 2 Shot Double net drive puck protection with pressure - 10 mins
Stickhandling.description:
On the whistle, 2 players leave from each line (3rd player needs to make 2 passes). 1st player (blue) skates with a puck over the dot and shoots (shot 1), then curls to the middle to locate the 2nd player (green) and apply pressure. On the initial whistle, the 2nd player (green) goes around a cone (left tight turn,inside to outside), receives a pass from the 3rd player in line, drives the net and shoots through the pressure from player 1 (the blue player). After the pressure and the 2nd shot is taken, player 1 (blue) turns toward the boards (right tight turn) and heads up the middle of the ice (breakout simulation). Player 2 (green) who just took the shot, supports the line and receives a pass (pass 2) up the middle from the 3rd player in the line. Player 2 (green) passes the puck up to player 1 who heads up ice to shoot at the other end. After the pass, player 2 recovers to apply pressure on Player 1 (blue) coming in from the other end. Both ends go at the same time

Key Points: Timing! Apply just enough pressure allowing for shots to be taken. Accurate ssing.

After a few times through, go the other direction VARIATION: Once the players can execute the move well, put a puck on their sticks and have them do a toe drag with their mohawk at each cone.

Stickhandling.name: Power Play - Positions / Requirements
Stickhandling.description: REQUIREMENTS FOR EACH POSITION ON POWER PLAY - ASSUMING AN “OVERLOAD” OR “UMBRELLA” SET-UP (see diagrams on next page): R1 (Quarterback) • Must be a great passer and stickhandler • Must have conﬁdence to be the last man back with the puck • Has to “see the ice” well • Needs an accurate shot (not necessarily hard) • Must be a quick skater R2 • Must have an excellent “one-timer” shot • Must be a good passer and stickhandler • Must have excellent poise with the puck (can’t panic under pressure) • Must understand the concepts of “give ‘n’ go” passing R3 • Must be a good passer and stickhandler • Must have excellent poise with the puck (can’t panic under pressure) • Must understand the concepts of “give ‘n’ go” passing L1 • Must have an excellent “one-timer” shot • Must be a good passer and stickhandler • Must be a quick skater R/L • Must be tough! • Must be strong, and be able to take a beating in front of the net • Must have a good sense of rebounds, and be ready to pound them in – R/L will score the most goals on a well executed power play, he will score what’s called “garbage goals,” meaning the ugly, hard working, rebound goals • Must be able to gain (and maintain) position in front of the goalie while shots are coming in – this will allow him to screen the goalie, and deﬂect shots into the net Note: It is every coach’s responsibility to know his team well enough to know which players are suited for which positions. A strong power play depends largely on who is in which position. Often, a dysfunctional power play can become great, just by moving one player to a different spot, or by switching two players. Don’t be afraid to experiment. POSITIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND SET-UPS: Left Overload Power Play Set-up Umbrella Power Play Set-up

Passing.description:

2. On the whistle, Player 1 skates the S-pattern, breaks up ice, receives a stretch pass from Player 2, and shoots.

4. After the pass, Player 2 breaks for a mid-distance stretch pass from the next player in Line 1 and shoots.
5. Repeat, alternating which line skates the S-pattern.

Passing.description: On the whistle, head towards the middle/front of the net with a puck. Stretch pass the puck to the next player in the other line at the other end. Passing.name: 2 shot retrieval with point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
4 cones are placed on all the neutral zone face off dots (nearest the blue lines) On the whistle, Both ends start simultaneously (F's and D's go at the same time) The F's (blue) skate around the cone into the center ice circle and retrieve a puck. The D's skate forward and pivot to backwards (around the cone) once the D's skating backwards and go over the blue line the F's pass (pass 1) the D's the puck. The F's continue under the cones (swinging low) on the other side and turn up ice (close to the boards). The D's step up (stop and skate forward) and pass (pass 2) the puck back to the F's who skate it down and shoots (shot 1 from the slot) and stays in front of the goalie/net (sets up screen). After the the 2nd pass the D's skate over top of the cone towards the line they came from and receive a pass (pass 3) from the next Dman in the line, then goes and shoots (shot 2) from close to the blue line (long shot, low and hard).

Passing.name: 2 shot screen/tip with a retrieval - 10 mins
Passing.description:
This drill is whistle generated. On the whistle the players lined up at the center ice red line along the boards, skate with a puck over the blue line and pass (pass 1) it to the front player lined up deep in the opposite corner. Player 1 who started with the puck now continues under the face off dot (swinging low and wide) and heads up the ice skating forward along the boards to receive the pass (pass 2) back from player 2 who has skated to the middle and up the dots. Player 1 carries the puck all the way down into the other end and takes a shot (shot 1) in close, then stays in front to set a screen. After player 2 passes (was pass 2) the puck to player
1. Player 2 now skates up through the neutral zone around the center face off circle and retrieves a puck on the other side (loose pucks located at the center red line near the boards). After the retrieval player 2 carries the puck just over the blue line (back into the end/zone they came from) and takes a long shot (shot 2) through the set screen with player 1 in front of the net.

Passing.name: 2 shot timing full ice (tip_screen) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
Both ends (all players) start simultaneously on the whistle. 4 cones are placed close to the end zone face off dots. Start without a puck, skate over the cone closest to your line, then across the ice under the cone on the other side. The blue players receive a pass (pass 1) from the red line and skate up around the cone and pass (pass 2) the puck across the ice to the red player, who has skated the same route the other way. The red player stays on that side of the ice and goes down the ice and shoots (shot 1) from the slot, stays in front of the goalie/net and sets up a screen. The blue player follows his pass(pass 2) across the ice and receives a pass (pass 3) from the same line they started from (blue line) and goes down and takes a longer shot (shot 2) with the red player waiting in front of the net.

Key Points: Shoot and stay in front for Screen/deflections. Precise passes. Low shots. member to switch sides.

Upon the retrieval, the red players (with timing) start skating across the ice ready to receive a pass (pass 3) from the blue players. The red players go down the ice to take a shot (shot 2). After the rep sequence the players switch lines.

Key Points: Red player line delay and timing.

Passing.name: 3 shot timing set play routes - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, Player 1 (green) starts with a puck and skates behind the net, Player 2 (blue) starts without a puck and skates behind the net to receive a drop pass (pass 1) behind the net. Upon the drop pass, Player 3 (red) with timing skates toward the slot and receives a pass (pass 2) from player 2 (blue) and shoots (shot 1) then goes in front and sets a screen. Player 1 (green) continues around the face off dot (staying low) and receives a pass (pass 3) from the green player line and shoots (shot 2) through the screen, then goes in front and sets a screen as well. (2 players in front now) Player 2 (blue) continues around the face off circle (going higher into the slot) and receives a pass (pass 4) from the blue player line and shoots (shot 3) through the double screen.

Key Points: Timing and awareness. Player remember to rotate lines.

Passing.name: 3 shot timing, D retrieval (point shot) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle the D's (red) skate over the blue line then pivots to backward and re- pivots to forward and retrieves a puck twice and makes 2 passes. Pass 1 is to F1 (blue) coming straight up the wall (along the boards) positions to post up (stationary) just below the center red line. F1 ( blue) receives the pass (pass 1) skates back in shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. Pass 2 from the D (red) is to F2 (green) who with timing does a deep neutral zone swing, receives the pass (pass 2) from the D (red) goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen in front of the goalie (2 players there now F1 & F2) The D (red) follows up ice and receives a pass (pass 3) from coach and takes point shot (shot 3) with F1 + F2 infront.

Key Points: F1 and F2 time the D's retrievals and set sticks on the ice for the pass from the D, look up for pass readiness + awareness Remember to switch sides.

Passing.name: 3 shot warm ups D-motion passers (tip_screen) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The D's (red) start skating forward from the center ice circle (to their right facing the offensive zone) and pivot to backward then receive a pass (pass 1) from the forward, F1 (blue) who with timing, skates with a puck out of the offensive zone. The D (red) passes (pass 2) the puck right back to F1 (blue) then goes in and shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. The D (red) then proceeds across the ice around the center face off circle and repeats the action on the other side with F2 (green) F2 (green) with timing passes (pass 3) the puck to the D, gets it right back (pass 4) then goes in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen in front of the goalie as well (F1 and F2 now in front). The D (red) now skates back again over to the other side (where started from) just crosses the blue line and receives a pass (pass 5) from the coach and takes a point shot (shot 3).

Key Points: Timing. Forwards should pass when the D's are skating backward!

Passing.name: 3 shot with touch passes, retrieval,point shot (tip/screen) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, 2 players start from each end skating out of the corner with a puck, 1 player skates backwards (red) and one player skates forwards (blue) face to face with a small gap. Passing a puck back and forth 3-4 times. Player 1 (blue) takes the puck on the last pass and goes over the face off circle and shoots (shot 1) Player 2 (red) opens up and skates down the ice to retrieve a puck at the top of the face of circle in the other end. Player 2 (red) turns towards the boards with the puck and skates back out into the neutral zone and passes (pass 2) the puck to player 1 (blue), who after the 1st shot goes wide to outside the blue line, receives pass 2 from player 2 (red) turning back into the same end, goes in and shoots (shot 2) then sets a screen in front of the goalie. Player 2 (red) follows up ice just over the blue line and receives a pass (pass 3) from the original line they started from, and takes a shot (shot 3) from the point.

Key Points: Timing and patience. Low shots from the point. Remember to switch sides!

Passing.name: 3 shots 3 depth retrievals for D point shot (tip_screen) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle both ends start simultaneously. The D (red) starts from the center ice circle, skates forward to the blue line, pivots to backward (to look/shoulder check for the forward) for a few strides. Then re- pivots to forward and retrieve a puck from the corner (puck pile 1) and skates it into the middle, heading up ice then passes (pass 1) it to F1 (blue) who with timing, skates deep down into the middle turning to the boards. F1 (blue) receives the pass (pass 1) and goes back down and shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen in front of the goalie. The Same D (red) skates up to the blue line stops and repeats the retrieval with F2 (blue) by going to puck pile 2 at the half wall (boards). The D (red) passes (pass 2) the puck to F2 (blue) who goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a second screen. The D (red) repeats (same routing) another retrieval from puck pile 3 skates to the middle, up ice and passes (pass 3) the puck to F3 (blue), who goes down and shoots through the double screen. OPTION: As an option after thte 3rd pass the D can go back and retrieve a 4th puck, skate it down and shoot (shot 4) from the point through a triple (3) player screen.

Key Points: Remember to switch sides.

Passing.name: 3 shots D- neutral zone retrievals - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle both side go simultaneously. The D's (red) start at the middle blue line, skate forward to loose puck pile at center ice, retrieve a puck and skate backwards with it back to the blue line, then pass it (1st pass) to the forward (blue) on the right side. The forward skates back into the initial zone, shoots (shot 1) and sets a screen. The D (red) repeats the same route retrieving a puck skating backwards to the blue line making a 2nd pass to the forward (blue) on their left side. F2 skate back into the initial zone and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. (2 forwards now in front of the goalie) The D (red) repeats the route, retrieve a 3rd puck and take into the zone and shoot (long shot #3) from just under the blue line.

Key Points: D, always pass to the right 1st, then to the left 2nd. F, post up at the center ice ards with stick on the ice and receive the pass on the forehand.

Passing.name: 3 shots with retrievals timing and tip/screens - 10 mins
Passing.description: y g p g p shots with retrievals timing and tip/screens - 10 mins On the whistle, the D (red) starts with a puck, takes a stride up the boards and passes (pass 1) it to the F (blue) who waits for the D to pivot to backwards, then passes (pass 2) it back to the D who touch passes (pass 3) back to the F. The F goes in and takes a shot (shot 1) after the shot the F vacates across the ice and back into the neutral zone. While the D after pass 3, goes in to retrieve a puck, (loose puck in the corner) skates it out to the blue line towards the middle, and gives the F a stretch pass (pass 4) who goes back in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. After pass 4, the D follows up, skates around the center ice circle, sets up at the point, (same side as the coach) receives pass from coach and shoots (shot 3) through the screen.

Passing.name: 3 shots, screen/tips 3 D-retrievals - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, the D skates forward to the top of the circle and pivots to backward towards the middle. Then re- pivots to forward, retrieves a puck from the corner and skates with it to the hash marks preparing to make a pass (The D does this action 3 times... 2 passes and then takes a point shot). The first forward, (blue) approaches from the far side boards center red line, swinging low in support of the D's first pass. That forward (blue) receives the 1st pass and goes down the ice and shoots (shot 1) and stays in front of the goalie to set a screen. The 2nd forward (green) comes straight down the boards, posts up and receives the 2nd pass from the D then goes down and shoots (shot 2) and sets a 2nd screen. The D (red) does a 3rd retrieval and carries the puck down the ice and takes the point shot (shot 3) through the double screen.

Key Points: D, always do shoulder checks. F's remember to set screens, but has the ability to and deflect the shots. All shots are hard and low!

Passing.name: 3 Zone Timing Drill
Passing.description: 1. Drill starts with a passer (P) in the circle 2. First player swings low, inside the blue line, and receives the pass in the ﬁrst green receiving zone 3. Receiver controls puck, then hits the second player in the second green receiving zone 4. Receiver takes a shot, picks up a puck from the circle, and hits the ﬁrst player of the other line in the ﬁrst red receiving zone. 5. Drill continues perpetually.

Passing.name: 3-MAN HORSESHOE
Passing.description: 35 KEY POINTS: • Follows 1-man and 2-man horseshoe as a progression • Support, weaving and moving as a unitk DESCRIPTION • X and O leave their ends without a puck • Players turn at pylon and receive a pass from the corner, takes puck to • the wall, while the passer takes the middle ice • X2 and O2 takes off in support • 1st player drifts to middle and passes to trailer • Trailer goes hard and wide, passes to 1st player in the slot for a shot • Trailer becomes 1st player and the drill be- comes continous

Passing.name: 3vs0 End to end warm ups with a point shot - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle the RW (right winger,blue) starts with a puck and passes it to the D (red) The D passes it right back to the RW and he/she passes it right back to the D (3 passes). Then the RW (blue) swings low and skates up the boards.(far side lane) With timing the C (center man, green) follows behind the RW and does a pass exchange (2 more passes) with the D as well. Then turns up the middle lane. Also with timing, the LW (yellow) waits for the pass completions and starts skating up the boards in their lane. The D (red) now with the puck, steps up and passes (pass 6) the puck to the LW (yellow) who advances/passes (pass 7) it immediately up to the C (green, center man) The C (green) carries the puck (driving wide and deep) over the blue line and can exercise 3 options.
1. Pass to the LW (yellow) driving the net
2. Pass to the RW (blue) in the high slot OR
3. Shoot! After the shot (shot 1) all the forwards position in front and set screens. The D (red) follows up the the blue line, stops, receives a pass from the coach (stationed in the corner) and shoots (shot 2) through the screen.

Key Points: Once over the blue line there is a 1 pass maximum rule then shoot immediately d swarm the blue paint, set up screen positions with the ability to tip/deflect. Alternate ds after each rep. Remember to switch sides.

Passing.name: 4 bump back passes around neutral - 10 mins
Passing.description: s at g c oss o e s (do t g t tu s) a e su e t e s ot s ta e be o e t e e t p aye goes Whistle generated. On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. Start backwards and back up and out towards the face off dot. Get a quick pass from the same line (while going backward) you started from right after the whistle. Pivot to forward and go clockwise around the center ice circle receiving passes and bumping (passing) the puck directly to all the lines. Receive the 5th pass from the original line your started from and go in and shoot! On the next whistle... the other adjacent players go the other (counter clockwise) way. KeKey Points: 2 players going at a time. Keep sticks on the ice. keep feet moving. Everyone head up and aware!

Passing.name: 4 Corner Passing
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 skates up and across the ice and receives a pass from Player 2. 2. Player 1 skates down the ice for a shot on net. VARIATION: 2 Pass - Player 1 makes a pass to Player 2 to start the drill. See Seq. # 2 for the 2 on 0 option

Passing.name: 4 Corner Passing (sequence 2)
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 skates up and across the ice and Player 3 follows. 2. Player 3 receives a pass from Player 2. 3. Players 1 & 3 attack 2 on 0. VARIATION: 2 on 1 - D steps out for a 2 on 1.

Passing.name: 4 Pass One Timer
Passing.description: 1. First player in line passes out to Player 1, then skates out to the NZ, then re-enters the zone, timing his/her arrival to the slot 2. Puck is passed from 1 to 2 to 3, then back to the slot for a one-time shot 3. Shooter becomes Player 3, 3 becomes 2, 2 becomes 1, and 1 gets back in line.

Passing.name: 8 pass drill - triangular set up (both ends) - 10 mins
Passing.description: The player starts with a puck, makes a long pass down to the low face off dot(1st pass). That player passes it right back (2nd pass) to the original player who gives in back again(3rd pass). The player at the low face off dot now passes the puck up to the line at the face off dot outside the blue line(4th pass). The original player skates up the boards, and receives a pass from the player outside the blue line face off dot (5th pass) and he passes it right back to that player again!(6th pass). Now the player outside the blue line, passes the puck down to the player at the low face off dot (7th pass). That player make the final (8th pass) pass to the original player who has skated around that line outside the blue line face off dot and heading down the middle to receive the puck and take the shot! Once the shot takes place... the shooter goes to the line closest to the net and they all complete a counter clockwise rotation. KeKey Points: Touch Passes Rotation Awareness Feet moving Stick on the ice Communication Elevated player focus helps with this drill

Passing.name: Attack Triangle Sequence (phase 1)
Passing.description: 1. Player (F1) leaves without puck, cuts across neutral zone 2. F1 receives pass in stride, then drives wide and shoots 3. After making the pass, ﬁrst player in other line does the same thing

Passing.name: Attack Triangle Sequence (phase 2)
Passing.description: 1. First player (F1) does same thing as in phase 1. 2. Second player in same line becomes F2. cuts inside ﬁrst cone, then drives wide and cuts to the net for a 1-timer

Passing.name: Attack Triangle Sequence (phase 3)
Passing.description: 1. F1 and F2 do the same thing as in phase 2 2. Player who makes pass becomes F3 and follows up the puck carrier to form an attack triangle 3. Work whatever options you need

Passing.name: Bank Pass Timing
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 skates across the ice. 2. Player 2 steps up with a puck and banks a pass off the boards. 3. Player 1 skates to the puck and makes a stretch pass to Player 2 on the opposite blue line for a shot on goal. 4. Player 1 continues and receives a pass in the slot for a shot on goal.

Passing.name: Break out simulation (soft dump,russian curl, triangular set up) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, both sides go at the same time. The D (red) leaves the center ice circle, skating backwards doing a 2 pass (pass 1 and 2) exchange, then pivots to forward and retrieves a soft dumped puck out from the same side corner. The D skates it behind the net OVER to the other side and passes (pass 3) it to F1 (blue) who left the blue line with timing and posted up at the hash marks along the boards. F2 (green) with timing, leaves the blue line, follows the D supporting the puck, swinging low in front of the net, skates toward F1 and receives a pass (pass 4) from F1 and breaks out with the puck. Now with the puck F2 (green) skates with the puck, staying wide all the way down deep into the other end and does a Russian curl, waiting for F1 (blue) to get to the net and the D (red) to reach the blue line. F2 now has 3 options (triple threat)
1. Shoot
2. Pass to F1 going to or at the net.
3. Pass to the D for the point shot. If the pass goes to the point, both forwards go to the net to set screens ready to tip/deflect

Passing.name: Breakout 2 on 0
Passing.description: 1. Forward passes to the defenseman, then supports in the role of the centerman 2. Defenseman skates the puck behind the net, then passes to the ﬁrst forward in the other line 3. Forward touch passes to the ﬁrst forward swinging through, who takes it down the ice and shoots 4. After shooting, the ﬁrst forward picks up a puck and hits the second forward, who is coming in as a “trailer man,” for a one-time shot

Passing.name: Bump pass with timing - 10 mins
Passing.description: Whistle generated. On the whistle, opposites go... skate overtop the circle, receive a pass and bump it right back. Go low to make time and space. Get the original puck passed back along the boards, then take shot. KeKey Points: bump passes (one, touch)

Passing.name: Butterﬂy Passing
Passing.description: 1. Two lines at one end, the width of the goal posts 2. Players skate in pairings all the way down the ice, passing back and forth while maintaining stride 3. At far end, players peel off, around the bottom of each's respective circle, then skate back making cross-ice passes back into the zone they started from VARIATION: Have d-men skate backward

Passing.name: Center Lag Timing
Passing.description: 1. Players line up in opposite corners 2. On whistle, 2 players leave from each line 3. First player from each line leaves without puck, skates up to the blue line and cuts across (staying on side) 4. Second player from each line leaves with puck, skates up and hits the ﬁrst player of the opposite line in receiving zone 5. Receiver takes puck wide, passer drives the net 6. After driving wide, ﬁrst player passes across to the second player for the one- timer VARIATION: Add 3rd player as a defenseman for a 2 on 1

Passing.name: Circle Passing
Passing.description: 1. Line up 6 players per circle (if you don't need all 5 circles, use the extra space for goalie work) 2. Players pass around the circle, skipping a player, and following the pass. 3. As long as there's an even number at the circle, it'll work out. With an odd number, players will have to stay stationary 4. Each passer will always receive from the same player, and pass to the same player VARIATIONS: Clockwise, counter clockwise, forehand, backhand, touch passes, saucer passes

Passing.name: Coach-to-Coach Give-and-Go
Passing.description: X will pass to coach to coach - X will hook around the cone and receive a puck from coach. Drill is complete unless a goalie is available.

Passing.name: Coach-to-Coach Passing Flow
Passing.description: 1 to coach - to other coach - both players hook as shown. 2 will hook around the dot. Coach will move the puck to 2. 2 will move the puck to 1. Drill is then complete unless goalies are available.

Passing.name: Continuous Angle Shots (d-neutral zone support with touch passes) - 10 mins
Passing.description: A whistle starts the drill. A defenseman leaves from the centre ice near the wall, skates across the ice down towards the opposite side neutral zone face off dot and pivots to backward. At this point, forward (with timing)leaves the hash mark with puck, skates towards blue line and passes it to the defenseman while skating backwards. That forward continues to skate up the boards, going outside the blue line, does a tight turn towards the face off dot (to the middle), and retrieves the touch-pass back from the defenseman, using the face off dot as a guide, then shoots. Defenseman alternates sides and repeats pattern 4 times. After 4th rep, next defenseman jumps in to continue drill. KeKey Points: "D" Clean Pivots and touch pass to an area ( use dots as a guide ) "F" tight turns outside the blue line "F", stay outside the dots (close to the boards) when entering the zone

Passing.name: Continuous D-D point shots, screens and defelctions - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle. One side starts. (Blue F) Go through the face off circle above the face off dot and take a shot. (check for a rebound and play it) Then immediately proceed to the loose puck pile on the same side you started from. Retrieve a puck and pass back to that same side D1. Then immediately get back to the front of the net. D1 who received the pass (pass 1) passes the puck across the blue line to D2 (D to D pass). D2 Shoots with the forward in front of the net/goalie (screen/deflection). After the shot, the forward plays any possible rebound then immediately goes to the puck pile on the other side of the net, and retrieves a puck and passes it back to D2 then gets back in front of the net. D2 passes it across the blue line to D1 (D-D pass) D1 shoots with the forward back in front the net/goalie. After the 2nd point shot, the forward plays any possible rebound then the forward goes back to that same side puck pile to retrieve a puck and pass it (pass 3) to the forward (green F) on that side to continue the drill with the same actions going the other way.

Key Points: Explosive stops and starts. Straight line routes. Low point shots D, D passing. od net presence and positioning.

Passing.name: Continuous double give and go - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts St c o t e ce ape to tape passes Continuous Drill starting with a whistle. Player leaves the line, skates up the wall and completes 2 give and go passes, then goes in, takes a shot and checks for a rebound. Shooter then goes back to fill outlet positions, making 2 passes on the way back to the starting line. KeKey Points: Timing Remember to fill the outlets after your shot Continuous! Always stay on the same side ending up back where you started.

Passing.name: Continuous follow your pass shooting from the "Red Zone" - 10 mins
Passing.description: To start the drill, first player in the corner passes across the front of the net to the player stationed on the blue line (point position) then follows their pass and takes that position. That player passes the puck down towards the goal line to another player stationed there. They follow their pass and take that position. That player passes the puck to the slot where the shooter comes in (timing),receives the pass and shoots (a one timer shot can be taken), then goes to the corner to line up. The player who passed into the slot now skates up through the zone into the neutral zone (timing) curls back down to receive the pass in the continuation. KeKey Points: Timing Tape to tape hard passes Stick awareness This is a Continuous drill... The next player goes once the shot has been taken.

Passing.name: Continuous multiple passes down the middle slot shot (warm up) - 10 mins
Passing.description: One side starts from the Blue line... Skate into the middle and pass the puck cross ice down to the line at the goal line. Continue across the Blue line and receive a pass from the line and bump (one touch) it right back. Continue around the cone (neutral face off dot) and head down the middle to receive a pass from one of the players in the lines at the goal line. Note: The players at the goal line continually pass exchange the original pass until its time to pass it to the shooter coming down the middle for the shot. Can be a one-timer! Once the shot is taken the other side can go. Be sure to rotate lines! KeKey Points: Timing Accurate Passes Head up

Passing.name: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 (blue) takes 2 steps forward into the middle then pivots immediately to backward. Exchange a pass with the player behind you (touch pass 1 and 2) while skating backward. Re-pivot to forward and head through the neutral zone and do another pass exchange (touch passes 3 and 4) with the player at the front of the line. Player 1 (blue) then swings low in a tight turn toward the boards and heads up the ice. Player 2 (red) takes 2 steps and passes (pass 5) the puck back to player 1 (blue) who goes in and shoots! Player 2 (red) immediately pivots to backward and receives a pass exchange to keep the drill going the other way! (Keeping it continuous)

Key Points: Timing and Awareness! Head on a swivel! After the shot alternate lines.

Passing.name: Continuous passing with pivots and a single shot) - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts g a d pass e ecut o On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 (blue) takes 2 steps forward into the middle then pivots immediately to backward. Exchange a pass with the player behind you (touch pass 1 and 2) while skating backward. Re-pivot to forward and head through the neutral zone and do another pass exchange (touch passes 3 and 4) with the player at the front of the line. Player 1 (blue) then swings low in a tight turn toward the boards and heads up ice. Player 2 (red) takes 2 steps and passes (pass 5) the puck back to player 2 (blue) who goes in and shoots! Player 2 (red) immediately pivots to backward receives a pass exchange to keep the drill going the other way! (Keeping it continuous) KeKey Points: Timing and Awareness! Head on a swivel! After shot alternate lines.

Passing.name: Continuous Regroup
Passing.description: 1. Players line up in each bench and go 3 at a time (extra defensemen on the bench too) 2. Forwards pass out to the defensemen, then execute a regroup with the ﬁrst set of defensemen, then another group with the second set of defensemen 3. After the second regroup, the forwards get off the ice, and the next set of forwards start the drill the other direction 4. This is designed to be a quick-paced drill, constantly rotating new forwards and defensemen in and out.

Passing.name: Continuous shooting bump passes (evaluation) - 10 mins
Passing.description: g,p g g p p p 1st player leaves with a puck and shoots at about the hash marks. Follow your shot to the net for a possible rebound. Stop in front of the net for a split second (on the rebound search) then head straight back to the line with your stick on the ice ready to receive a pass from the next player. The next player makes that pass with their feet moving they get a one touch (bump back) pass and continue the drill. KeKey Points: Straight to the net after the shot. stick on the ice with 2 hands on the stick! Both ends and switch sides after 4, 5 minutes

Passing.name: Continuous short horseshoe (angle passing) - 10 mins
Passing.description: t p o de ect Leave line go around the cone, exchange the puck, skate all the way down to the other end and shoot (plenty of puck carrying time) Once the last pass is made, the player continues the same route. Switch sides (3 minutes per side) KeKey Points: Continuous feet moving accurate passing

Passing.name: Continuous stretch pass up the dots (timing and retrievals) - 10 mins
Passing.description: e ated p aye ocus e ps t t s d The drill starts on the whistle with one player in each end starting from near beside the net. They go behind the net to retrieve a puck come out with their feet moving and make a hard pass to a player who comes down from the blue line (timing) and posts (sets) up just above the hash marks. That player skates towards the dot line and heads up ice with their feet moving, then passes the puck up the dot line through the neutral zone to a player who jumps off the wall heading to the face off dot just outside the blue line (with timing and staying on-side) That player goes towards the net, shoots then retrieves to keep the drill going and continuous. KeKey Points: Both sides execute simultaneously at the same time. Timing Switch sides (3+ minutes per side) Feet moving when passing Remember to retrieve a puck after your shot.

Passing.name: Continuous swing with a bump pass (evaluation) - 10 mins
Passing.description: s tc s des a te, 5 utes One side starts... go in on an angle take a quick release shot! (check for a feasible rebound) Then head over to the other side with your stick on the ice ready to do a puck exchange (bump Pass) for the other play to continue the drill. Its continuous going from side to side in both ends. KeKey Points: Stick on the ice Feet moving when passing check for rebounds

Passing.name: Continuous touch passes (slot shot) with pivots/evasions - 10 mins
Passing.description: speed This is a continuous drill with touch passes,pivots,evasions and a single shot. Both ends can be done at the same time. One player skates backwards and one player skates forwards, passing the puck back and forth 2-3 times... keeping a consistent gap (about a stick length apart. When the backwards skater gets outside the blue line, he/she takes the pass and does an evasion spin or opens up and takes the puck and goes in and shoots. The forward skater heads across and down to the other side, pivots and now becomes the backwards skater (the backwards skater is the shooter). KeKey Points: Stick on the ice Tape to tape passes

Passing.name: Continuous warm up with timing and positioning - 10 mins
Passing.description:
The drill starts on a whistle then remains continuous. On the whistle to start the drill, player 1 located just below the face off circle beside the net, goes behind the net and retrieves a puck and passes it (pass 1) to player 2 at the hash marks (break out simulation) who started at the face off dot outside the blue line on that same side Player 2 then skates across the ice and down the boards (to post up at the hash marks) and receives the pass from player
1. Player 3 (the shooter), starts at the boards at center ice, skates across the ice along the center red line, goes down the boards heading back the other way (similar to a 360 degree circle), swinging low through the face off circles in support to receive the pass (pass 2) from player 2 located at the hash marks. Player 3 now with the puck, goes down and shoots and keeps the drill continuous by turning into player 1, by immediately retrieving a puck after the shot behind the net, continuing the drill and completing the rotation. The yellow lines indicates where to rotate to.

Key Points: To start the drill, Player 1 (retrieves and passes to player 2) Then rotates to yer 2 line. Player 2 (posts up at the hash marks and passes to player 3) Then rotates to yer 3 line. Player 3 (Long skate 360°, supports the break out pass) Go down and shoot! rning into player 1 continuing the rotation.

Passing.name: continuous warm up/timing slot shot (follow your pass) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
y g y p p g g ntinuous warm up/timing slot shot (follow your pass) - 10 mins one side starts, skate up over the neutral face off dot,,,make sure to swing wide, go down the middle... receive a pass from the hash marks on a give and go. (that player passes the puck to the other side (blue long) follow the pass and go line up. Skate up behind that player in a supportive position. (receive the pass and go down the middle and shoot. This is continuous... (green players get a give and go then follow their pass) (blue players support and shoot)

Key Points: Timing and support Use both ends of the ice.

Passing.name: Continuous warm-ups full ice using cones - 10 mins
Passing.description: Whistle to start the drill then it becomes continuous. On the whistle, 2 players start with a puck by skating out of corners going all the way down the ice along the boards, proceeding past the far blue line around the cone and passes (pass 1) the puck to the front player (who moved out a bit) in the opposite line. The players continue skating across the ice swinging low, going in front of the player they passed the puck to and turning at the boards heading up ice. The players now receive the return pass (pass 2) while heading up the ice, proceed to go down the ice and shoot at the net in the same end you started from. To keep the drill continuous, after the return pass is made that player skates over top of the cone and gets a puck passed out (pass 3) from the line they just came out of, and proceeds to continue the drill and do the same.

Passing.name: Coquahalla Swing
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 takes a shot on goal and picks up a new puck in the corner. 2. Both Players 2 and 3 swing out. 3. Player 1 makes a pass to 2, then 2 makes a pass to 3. 4. Player 3 takes a shot on goal and continues to the corner. 5. The drill is continuous.

Passing.name: Cross ice passing (use C or rotate D's as give and go passers) - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts u d o e tu ccu ate pass g t e de ay Go towards the middle, receive a pass from the other line, turn up the dots, do a give + go with the coach (or D-man ) then go in on net and shoot. Opposite corners go.. alternate and ensure to switch lines to receive passes on forehand and backhand. KeKey Points: Set stick target on the ice.

Passing.name: Cross-Ice Pass, One Time Shots
Passing.description: 1. Drill starts with a passer on the circle, just for the ﬁrst rotation 2. Passer swings low around the cone, and receives a pass from the ﬁrst person in the far line 3. After receiving the pass, the puck carrier skates outside the zone, then reenters the zone, running a give and go one timer with the player who made the pass 4. After making the ﬁrst pass, the player from the other line skates out for the give and go, then circles below the cone to receive the cross-ice pass from the far line 5. Drill continues perpetually

Passing.name: Cycle Give and Go
Passing.description: 1. Player 1 leaves with the puck and walks up the boards 2. He/she cycles back to Player 2, who is dropping down for back-side support 3. Player 1 drives through the seam for a give and go pass from the corner, receives the pass from Player 2, then one-touches to Player 3 or 2 for a one-timer VARIATIONS: As players progress, allow Player 1 to either shoot, pass to Player 3, or pass to Player 2. This ﬂexibility will keep the goalie from cheating on the play

Passing.name: CYCLONE
Passing.description: 43 KEY POINTS: • Hard tape-to-tape passes • Keep head up through middle of the ice • Pass ahead of moving player DESCRIPTION • X1 starts with puck, passes across ice to X3 • X1 skates along blue line, X3 passes back when X1 gets half way across ice • X1 makes touch pass up ice and skates along far blue line and receives a stretch pass from their starting line • X2 repeats on opposite side

Passing.name: Czech 1-Timer
Passing.description:
1. Player 1 walks in and fires a hard bank pass into the quiet zone behind the net.
2. Player 2 picks it up and hits Player 1 for a one-time shot.
3. Coach fires a puck into the corner as the shot is taken.
4. After shooting, Player 1 peels into the corner, retrieves the dump-in, steps out, and hits Player 2 for a one-time shot.

Passing.name: D ATTACKS 4 PUCK DRILLS
Passing.description: 9 KEY POINTS: • Changing points of attack • At the point if 1 timer isn’t right don’t force it, catch & releae in motion • Allow Ds to be scoring threats & comfortable with pucks below tops of circle DESCRIPTION D1 & D3 work together, D2 & D4 work together, and switch after each sequence 1. D3 indirect to D1 for 1 timer 2. D1 “Dive” inside dots, D3 pass from corner or skates up wall to- wards hash marks pass to D1, on & off stick, D1 stay at net for tips 3. D4 pass to D2 for low to high direct pass 1 timer 4. D 4 then up towards blue leaving outside lane for D2 & drop pass “High Cycle”

Passing.name: D OZ RIMS FOR ATTACKS
Passing.description: 7 KEY POINTS: • catch puck, separate from boards in case D needs to protect puck or cut back DESCRIPTION 1. rims puck, D 1 dives down, in area Option A) shoot on net or for tips, if carried to area Option B) keep puck, keep moving, look for F to pop out for pass

Passing.name: D to D Quick Pass Re-group
Passing.description:
Option 1:
1. Forward passes to the defensemen.
2. D-to-D pass, then hit the forward looping wide.
3. Forward attacks 1-on-0.

Option 2:
1. Forward passes to the defensemen.
2. D-to-D pass, then hit the forward looping wide.
3. Headman to the stretch man.
4. Stretch man delays and hits the other forward coming in late.

Passing.name: D to D timing and stretch pass - 10 mins
Passing.description: This drill is whistle generated. 4 Defensemen line up just under the blue line even with the face off dots. The rest of the players line up in opposite adjacent corners with the pucks. On the whistle the players (green and blue) skate out of the corner up the boards with a puck and pass (pass 1) it to same side, nearest D (red) continue to skate in front of that D and skate all the way across the ice, going deep behind the far side D, getting over to and proceeding up the boards. The D's will do a 2 pass (pass 3 and 4) exchange D to D. The final pass (pass 4) is the stretch pass across the ice. Players receive the pass, stay wide, go in and shoot.

Passing.name: Delay Drill
Passing.description: Option 1: 1. Player 1 skates with a puck around the low pylon. 2. Player 2 skates around the high pylon. 3. Player 1 makes a pass to player 2 for a shot on goal. 4. Play the rebounds. Switch sides. Option 2: 1. Player 1 skates with a puck around the low pylon. 2. Player 2 skates around the high pylon. 3. Player 3 skates wide to the far post. 4. Player 1 passes to 2 or 3 for a shot.

Passing.name: Double Bank Pass
Passing.description: 1. 4 lines, each with pucks 2. On whistle, two players leave from diagonally opposite lines. 3. The ﬁrst player ﬁres a cross-ice pass to the opposite line, then skates up ice to receive the ﬁrst bank pass. 4. Receiver steps out to create a good passing angle, then executes a bank pass to the player who passed to him. 5. The second player skates further up ice, timing it to be ready to receive the second bank pass from the ﬁrst player in his line. 6. Both players attack 2 on 0.

Passing.name: Drill #3 Carousel Shooting
Passing.description: Both sides will go at the same time. Both X1's take off without a puck, skating around the cones to the opposite line. Once X1 begins to cut near the opposite line, X2 will cross under X1 with a puck. X2 will t a direct pass to X1. X1 will begin to proceed towards the net they originally started ne After X2 passes to X1, X2 restarts the drill and skates outside the conesÂ to the opposite line.

Passing.name: Drill #4 Hershey Bears Puck Exchange
Passing.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC The first player in each line of X1 will take off skating towards the other end of the ice carrying a puck. X1 will pass his puck to the opposite X1 for a puck exchange. Once completed, players will end up in the opposite end and go in the line they didn't pass to. This will assure players are working on both their forehand and backhand passes.

Passing.name: Drill #5 Shooting Warm Up Stations
Passing.description: © Copyright HockeyCoach.com Vision Hockey LLC Station 1 (left side of diagram) All players start with a puck. X1 skates around first cone for a shot on net. After the shot, X1 stays in front of the net to tip and screen the goalie for shots from players X2 & X3. X2 skates out the middle of the ice and hooks around the cone as shown. Skating in and shooting on net. After X2's shot is complete, X2 goes back in the corner. X3 skates on the outside of all cones, and can shoot the puck with X1 screening the play. X1 can also open up in front of the net and communicate for a back door pass resulting in a shot on net from X1. Station 2 (right side of diagram) X1 skates full speed around the top of the circle receiving a pass from X2 in motion. Once X1 receives the pass from X2. X2 skates around the cone near the dot and receives a pass from their own line. X2 skates in for a shot on net. After X2 shoots the puck. X1 on the opposite side restarts the drill. Quick Tips: Switch sides half way in. Focus on having a quick release. Shoot on stride. Aim for the corners and have a plan. Don't just throw the puck on net.

Passing.name: Drill 4: Passing X - 1 - 2 - 3
Passing.description: Explanation: X starts with the puck and passes to 1. 1 receives the puck and pivots passing to 2. 2 gets the puck and passes to 3. 3 goes in for a shot on net. Players will follow their pass and go to the next line.

Passing.name: Drill 5: Passing - Plant Your Feet & Drive
Passing.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: If over 6 players, utilize both sides of the ice as shown. If not, use only one side at a time. This drill moves quickly. 2 will be stationary on the blue line. 1 will pass to 2. 2 will skate backwards to center ice and plant their feet into the ice. Moving the puck with power and on the ice to player 3. 3 will go in and shoot. 2 will move to the 3 spot and 1 will move to spot 2.

Passing.name: Drill 6: Puck Movement 2-0
Passing.description: g p p Explanation: On the whistle, 1 will move the puck quickly to 2. 2 will enter the zone and will need to move the puck quickly back to 2. 2 must enter the zone with speed but widen out to create separation in the offensive zone.

Passing.name: Drill 7: Puck Movement
Passing.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: 1 will skate below the cones and to the wall. 2 will loop in front of line 1. Coach will pass to player 1. 1 will receive the puck and quickly move it to the middle for player 2. Player 2 will skate in and shoot and move to line 1. Player 1 will move to line 2.

Passing.name: Drill 8: Puck Movement
Passing.description: Explanation: On the whistle - utilize one side a time if less than 6 players. 1 will pass to 2. Net or obstacle will be placed where player must pass the puck back quickly behind it and drive for the rebound.

Passing.name: Drop Pass / Wide Support
Passing.description: 2 will move the puck to 1. 1 will drop the puck just inside the blue line. 1 will then hook wide as shown. Widening out the ice. 2 will retrieve the drop and move the puck back to 1. 1 will shoot.

Passing.name: EHCKK 1
Passing.description: 45 KEY POINTS: • Quick passes • Keep your feet moving DESCRIPTION • Drill is run from both ends (only one shown) • X1 passes cross ice to X3, X3 passes right back • X1 passes to X2, then pivots and skates hard through the neutral zone • X 2 passes cross ice to second player inX1 line, who then makes a • quick pass to the streaking X1 • Second player joins in rush and goes hard to the far post

Passing.name: Farjestad 3 Pass (phase 1)
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 makes a cross-ice pass to Player 2 and follows the pass. 2. Player 2 makes a cross-ice pass to Player 3. 3. Player 1 continues to the far blue line and receives a stretch pass from Player 3 for a shot on goal.

Passing.name: Farjestad 3 Pass (phase 2)
Passing.description: Double Stretch Pass: 1. On the whistle, Player 1 makes a cross-ice pass to Player 2 and follows the pass. 2. Player 2 makes a cross-ice pass to Player 3. 3. Player 1 continues to the far blue line and receives a stretch pass from Player 3. 4. Player 1 makes a quick pass to the other Player 2, then loops to the other blue line. 5. Player 2 makes a cross-ice pass to the other Player 1, who makes a stretch pass to Player 1 for a shot on goal.

Passing.name: Figure 8 Multi Pass and Shot
Passing.description: 1. Give and receive touch passes with the coach while skating full speed through the ﬁgure 8 2. After the ﬁnal touch pass, let a quick shot go 3. Drill should be run at a quick tempo to minimize wait time. Also works well in station practices.

Passing.name: Finesse Hockey Passing Drill
Passing.description:
1. Player 1 skates through the slot and receives a pass from Player 2.
2. As Player 1 skates through the slot, Player 4 carries a puck to the net for a shot.
3. Player 1 passes to Player 3 and continues through the neutral zone.
4. Player 3 passes to the Player 1 line.
5. Player 1 receives a return pass from the line and shoots.

Variation: Player 1 starts with a pass to Player 4. Player 4 passes across to Player 2, then attacks the net for a shot. Player 2 passes to Player 1 in the slot.

Passing.name: Full Ice Horseshoe
Passing.description: 1. Only one side is shown. The drill is continuous. 2. On the whistle, Player 1 skates up the ice and receives a pass from Player 2 in the high slot. 3. Player 1 makes a touch pass back to Player 2 who has stepped out to the middle. 4. Player 1 continues to the boards and receives a return pass from Player 2 for a shot on net. 5. Player 2 skates to the boards and starts the drill from the other side

Passing.name: Full ice warm up end to end (down and back) - 10 mins
Passing.description: One side starts... head across the ice through the slot receive a pass from the other side using the face off dots as a guide to receiving the pass (stick on the ice@ 2 hands on the stick!) Skate through the neutral zone with the puck on the forehand side of your body (puck in a prepared position) ready to be released at any time! Go down and back 2-3 times shoot from various depths and gaps space from the net. Then progress to another route adding passes etc etc... Note: Always stay on the same side to get forehand and back hand pass receives! KeKey Points: Hard passes with feet moving to build momentum Handling the puck in a prepared position

Passing.name: full ice warm up end to end last progression - 10 mins
Passing.description: All players start in one end. One side starts head towards the middle using the face off circle as a guide. turn towards the boards (outside) heading back to the line you started in receive a pass and pass it back (one touch puck exchange) Then go towards the other side just on top of the goalies crease... get a pass from that line and pass it right back again (one touch puck exchange) Continue wide to the boards the player you did the 2nd pass back to moves their feet with the puck toward the middle and passes it to the player going up the boards. Then after the pass up that player continues the drill by turning back to the line they came out of and continues the drill to the other side. Keep going until all players get a shot then come back the other way. KeKey Points: Direct and firm (hard) passes. Keep the puck on the forehand side all the way down the ice

Passing.name: Full ice warm ups end to end alternate with timing and options - 10 mins
Passing.description: pos t o ONE side starts -> player skate over top of face -off circle - receives pass touches it back head up the wall get puck back from player (feet moving) go the other way continuous KeKey Points: Touch passes stick on the ice feet moving

Passing.name: Full Speed Breakout Formation (seq. 1)
Passing.description: 1. D to D to Wing 2. D to D to Wing 3. D to D to Wing, one-touch to Center 4. D to D to Wing, one-touch to D who follows up play 5. Start again from the other side Variation: Put defensemen on far blue line for a 1 on 1.

Passing.name: Full Speed Breakout Formation (seq. 2)
Passing.description: 2 on 1 Option 1. F to D 2. D to D Pass 3. Board-side breakout to C swinging through 4. F loops in behind C for a 2 on 1

Passing.name: Full Speed Breakout Formation (seq. 3)
Passing.description: 1. Ring to chip 2. Ring to chip 3. D to D to Center (chip around coach) 4. D to D, pivot toward boards and Walk (chip around coach)

Passing.name: Full Speed Breakout Formation (seq. 4)
Passing.description: 1. D to D to F to D to Weak-side F 2. Same thing other way 3. D to D to C (direct pass) 4. D to D, skate behind net, cut tight and walk

Passing.name: Give & Go Timing
Passing.description: 1. Players leave corners at same time on whistle and perform give and go with player at center line 2. After receiving the give and go pass, players who left corners will take a shot, then swing to pick up a pass from the next player in line 3. After completing the give and go pass, the player at center ice will skate around the circle TOWARD the passing corner (clockwise in this example), and time it to receive a pass in his or her receiving zone 4. After picking up the pass from the next player in line, the player who took the ﬁrst shot will control the puck then hit his give and go partner for a breakaway pass.

Passing.name: Goalie Headman Drill
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, player 1 dumps a puck on the G. 2. The G makes a pass to 2. 3. 3 steps out and receives a pass from 2. 4. 3 skates up the ice and dumps the puck on the G. 5. No shots.

Passing.name: HIGH ROLL
Passing.description: 17 DESCRIPTION 1. F moves puck low to high to D, F follows pass 2. D walks to middle and finds F for high roll 3. F walks up wall and attacks net 4. F retrieves puck behind net and finds D in middle, weakside or strongside

Passing.name: Hymas Square Passing
Passing.description: 1. Players in opposite corners pass straight ahead 2. Passes go around the square 3. Players who started the drill skate around the circle and receive pass back from the same line they left from

Passing.name: Indirect passing with shots(2) - 10 mins
Passing.description: On the whistle both side start simultaneously. The F's located on the blue line facing in against the boards takes a couple of strides (staying wide) skating toward the face off dot and gives an in-direct (bank) pass the Defense man. The Defense man leaves the opposite face off dot on the same whistle starts backward (looking up ice) and pivots to forward to locate (search) the forwards pass off the boards (banked behind the net) The forward follows his initial pass (supporting the puck) then skates up ice just over the face off circle positioning to receive a return in- direct pass back from the Defense man. The forward makes any adjustments needed to control the pass from the defense man then takes the puck down to the other end and shoots. KeKey Points: Quick starts Full speed head up awareness Remember to switch sides

Passing.name: Larsen Give & Go
Passing.description: 1. First player leaves hash mark, turns the corner and receives a pass from the next player in line. 2. He then carries the puck around the next cone, and does a give and go with the passer at the red line. 3. After receiving the pass back from P, he does another give and go with the P in the corner, then ﬁres a one-timer on net. Variation: have your players use the inside mohawk to round the turns.

Passing.name: Long pass single shot warm up with timing and rotation - 10 mins
Passing.description: p aye goes o ce t e s ot as bee ta e Both sides start simultaneously on the whistle. The player passes the puck down across the ice to the player at the hash marks on the wall and continues to skate under and across the blue line proceeding around the other side face off dot back into the middle. The initial pass gets passed all the back to the starting position where the next player in line re- passes the puck to the original player coming into the middle. The initial player receives the pass and goes down the middle to shoot and heads to the bottom line near the hash marks on the wall. The Player stationed at the hash mark makes their pass and heads straight up the wall to join the line at the far blue line to complete the rotation. KeKey Points: Long passes with a Rotation + timing Build momentum Low shots

Passing.name: Long/Short Passing (seq. 1)
Passing.description: Long Pass: 1. On whistle, ﬁrst player breaks wide, cuts up ice, and receives a pass from the next player in line 2. After receiving the pass, player attacks the net hard for a shot

Passing.name: Long/Short Passing (seq. 2)
Passing.description: Short Pass: 1. On whistle, ﬁrst player in line cuts around the cone and receives a saucer pass from the next player in line 2. After receiving the pass, the player attacks the net hard for a shot.

Passing.name: Low Regroup, 2 on 1
Passing.description: 1. Players 1, 2, 3, & 4 all start on whistle 2. Defenseman skates to the top of the circle, receives a pass from 1 or 3, then skates the circle, pivoting to stay facing up ice 3. 1, 2, 3, & 4, all loop and receive a return pass from the opposite defenseman 4. After receiving the return pass, 1 & 2 and 3 & 4 attack 2 on 1 against the D they started the drill with 5. Defensemen close gap

Passing.name: Monkey in the Middle
Passing.description: Monkey in the middle.

Passing.name: multiple elements and shots with a cycle and point shot - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, The D (red) skates forward out from the center face off circle and pivots to backwards around the cone. F1 (green) with timing, starts to skate forward and passes (pass 1) the puck to the D. The D re-pivots to forward with the puck and passes (pass 2) it to F2 (blue) with timing started to skate up ice. F1 (green) skates all the way across to receive a pass back (pass 3) or retrieve a chip off the boards from F2. F1 (green) skates wide and enters the zone with the puck and passes (pass 4) it back to F2 (blue) who skates into the middle. F2 (blue) receives pass 4 and shoots (shot 1). Right after the shot, F2 (blue) goes into the corner to retrieve a puck with F1 (green) following behind ready for a cycle drop pass. Right after F2 drop passes the puck to F1, F2 then goes to the net to set up a near side screen. F1 now with the puck, passes (pass 5) it to the D (red) who followed the Forwards and positioned at point. After the pass (pass 5), F1 (green) goes to the net to set up a far side screen. With patience or once the screens are set, the D shoots (shot 2) from the point.

Key Points:

Passing.name: Multiple elements team challenge - 10 mins
Passing.description:
All players are located at center ice close to the boards on one side.
1. 3 on 0 2. 3 on 1 3. 3 on 2 4. D breakaway
1. On the whistle 3 forwards leave without a puck, skate low and across in front of the net to receive a pass (pass 1) from the coach (the coach can pass to any forward) they go down and Attack 3 on
0. After the shot,
2. The same 3 forwards swing low towards the corner and receive a pass (pass 2) from the coach. A single defense man, with timing jumps in to defend and make it a 3 on 1 going back the other way. After the shot or the play breaks down,
3. The same 3 forwards swing low towards the corner and receive a pass (pass 3) from the coach, 2 new defense men jump in and make it a 3 on 2 going back again the other way. After the shot or the play breaks down,
4. One of those 2 defense men receive a pass (pass 4) from the coach, going on a breakaway (untouched) trying to score. The next forwards line goes in the opposite direction.

Key Points: This can be a forwards vs defense men challenge. If the forwards score or get a ot on goal for 1 point for each. If the defense break up the play or score on the breakaway 1 point for each. Go through all the forward lines twice keeping tally of the score.

Passing.name: Multiple shots (X3) and elements with a single cycle simulation to point shot - 10 mins
Passing.description:
ns On the whistle a forward comes out of the corner across the front of the net and receives a pass (pass 1) from the D in the opposite corner. The forward goes down the ice along the dot line to the other end and takes a shot (shot 1) Then the forward heads to the other end opposite corner and receives a pass (pass 2) from a defenceman in that line. The forward carries that puck to the Hash on the wall and gives a cycle drop pass off the wall back to the D (stepping up in support). The forward continues to skate over top of the face off circle and gets the puck back (pass 3) in the middle and shoots (shot 2) After the 2nd shot the forward goes in front and sets a screen ready for a point shot. After the 3rd pass the defenceman skates around the face off circle (always facing up ice/pivoting) heading straight up the boards and stops at the point (blue line) in the other end. The defenceman receives a pass (pass 4) from one of the forwards in the same side corner, drags or goes to the dots for a point shot (shot 3)

Key Points: Timing. Accurate passes. Remember to switch sides.

Passing.name: Multiple shots and elements - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle the forwards (blue) leaves with a puck and skates towards the D (red) Letting the D come up and then pivot to backwards. The forward passes (pass 1) to the D (ensuring the D is skating backwards with his/her stick on the ice) The D immediately touch passes (pass 2) the puck back to the forward who goes in and shoots (shot 1) Right after the shot the forward circles to the boards, skates up and out into the neutral zone, while the D retreats deep across into the corner to retrieve a spotted/loose puck and skates with it straight up and outside the zone. The D (red) passes (pass 3) the puck to the forward into the neutral zone who turns up ice, goes in a and shoots (shot 2) then sets a screen in front of the goalie awaiting a point shot. After the 3rd pass the Defenceman follows up to the middle of the blue line, stops, receives a pass from the coach in the corner and shoots (shot 3) through the screen.

Key Points: Both ends go simultaneously. Timing. Accurate passes. Remember to switch es

Passing.name: Multiple shots with timing (individual skills) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, both ends all 4 players start simultaneously. The blue players start forward from the blue line, turn to backwards skate to the center red line then re-pivot to forward. Receive a pass (pass 1) from the same line they started from, go in and shoot (shot 1, from the slot) Meanwhile on the same whistle the green players skates with a puck, weaving through pre-set cones (pylons) taking a low/close shot (shot 2) After shot 2 (green player) positions into the slot. The blue player after shot 1 goes into the same side corner to retrieve a loose puck, comes up and out of the corner and passes (pass 2) it to the green player positioned in front for shot
3. Key Points: Timing and positioning. Remember to switch sides and the players should ernate lines.

Passing.name: Neutral zone across the blue pass options - 10 mins
Passing.description:
This drill can be whistle generated or timed by the players. Option
1. (Blue) Start backwards without a puck along the blue line. Receive a pass while skating backwards and pass it right back (passes 1 & 2). Then pivot to forward and receive a pass from the line at the other side and pass it right back (passes 3 & 4). Then skate up into the neutral zone continuing around the center ice face off dot and back down through the middle. The player from the other side who now has the puck passes (pass 5) all the back across the blue line to the next/front player in line. That player now passes (pass 6) it to the original player who started the drill. He/she takes the puck down the middle and shoots. Option
2. (red) Start backwards with a puck going straight along the blue line. When reaching the face off dot, pass back to the front player in the line and get a return pass right back (passes 1 & 2). Pivot to forward with the puck then pass (pass 3) the puck across to front player in the line at the other side. That player will return the pass (pass 4). Then go in and shoot.

Key Points: Sticks on the ice and set good pass targets. All players pay attention.
