Passing.name: Neutral zone D-D simulation stretch pass to a shot - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts St c o t e ce accu ate passes e e be to s tc s des On the whistle the player in the opposite adjacent lines go. Player 1 skates up and receives a pass (pass 1) from the player in in the directly on front of them. Player 1 taking a few stride into the middle passes (pass 2) the puck across the ice to front player in that line. That player simulates a D-D cross ice pass (pass 3) to the player where the puck originally came from. Player 1 continues around the center ice circle staying on side and receives the original puck stretched passed (pass 4) goes in and shoots! KeKey Points: Everyone aware! Tape to tape passing!

Passing.name: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Pattern 1 - 10 mins
Passing.description: On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. In this pattern Player 1 leaves the line with a puck.. Skate straight ahead and pass (pass 1) to the first player in line. Player 1 then skates below the blue line (to make time for the other players to complete a passing sequence) continuing around and using the center ice circle as a guide. Passes 2 and 3 are a D-D and back to D simulation. Pass 4 is then made to Player 1 staying on- side receiving the pass going in and taking a shot. On the next whistle, the other players go the other way! KeKey Points: 2 players are executing the drill on each whistle. Done at control and timing speed ensuring to stay on, side. All players, heads up and aware.

Passing.name: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Pattern 2 - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 leaves with a puck. Skate straight ahead and pass (pass 1) the puck to the first player in front of the line. (straight ahead) Player 1 crosses the center red line and pivots to backward (always facing the puck) then re-pivots to forward (doing a 360 degree circle) and skates to the middle. Pass 2 is a D-D simulated pass. Pass 3 is passed up ice to Player 1 who stays on-side receives the pass goes in and shoots. On the next whistle the other players go the other way!

Key Points: 2 players are doing the drill on each whistle. The drill is executed at a control d timing speed. Players should pivot low to make time for the passing sequence. Always e the puck when pivoting.

Passing.name: Neutral zone face off dots warm ups Patterns 2 - 10 mins
Passing.description: e su g to stay o, s de p aye s, eads up a d a a e On the whistle opposite diagonal players go. Player 1 leaves with a puck. Skate straight ahead and pass (pass 1) the puck to the first player in front of the line. (straight ahead) Player 1 crosses the center red line and pivots to backward (always facing the puck) then re- pivots to forward (doing a 360 degree circle) and skates to the middle. Pass 2 is a D-D simulated pass. Pass 3 is passed up ice to Player 1 who stays on-side receives the pass goes in and shoots. On the next whistle the other players go the other way! KeKey Points: 2 players are doing the drill on each whistle. The drill is executed at a control and timing speed. Players should pivot low to make time for the passing sequence. Always face the puck when pivoting.

Passing.name: Neutral Zone warm up - 10 mins
Passing.description: This drill is whistle generated... Opposite diagonals go. On the whistle the players carry a puck towards the middle and continue through the neutral zone going all the way around the center face off circle then passes the puck to the opposite side first player in line.(from the same end they started from) Then heads toward the net and receives a pass from the same line the player started from. Go in and shoot.

Passing.name: Newton Drag Skate Regroup
Passing.description: 1. D picks up a puck and drag skates back toward the middle (keep chest open and square) 2. D to D pass then breakaway pass to F 3. Other D picks up a puck, starts the same thing the other way.

Passing.name: NZ Basic Square
Passing.description: 1. One line at each blue line, on the boards 2. On the whistle, players from diagonal lines pass to the line straight ahead of them, then skate the route as shown, timing their skating to arrive on time, with speed. 3. Puck is received, then ﬁred across to the next player in the starting lines 4. Touch pass to player who started the drill 5. Attack 1 on 0 at each end 6. On the next whistle, the opposite two lines go

Passing.name: NZ Timing (seq. 1)
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, player 1 makes a pass to 2. 2. 2 makes a cross-ice pass to 3 and then skates up the ice. 3. 1 mirrors the puck and receives a pass from 3. 4. Stretch pass to 2 for a shot on the G.

Passing.name: NZ Timing (seq. 2)
Passing.description:
1. On the whistle, Player 1 passes to Player 2.
2. Player 2 makes a cross-ice pass to Player 3, then skates up ice.
3. Player 1 mirrors the puck and receives a pass from Player 3.
4. Player 1 makes a stretch pass to Player 2.
5. Player 2 delays in the corner and passes to Player 1 for a shot.

Passing.name: NZ Timing & Support (seq. 1)
Passing.description:
1. Player 1 skates up with a puck and passes to Player 2, who supports in the neutral zone.
2. Player 2 returns the puck to Player 1 and follows up ice.
3. Player 1 shoots while Player 2 turns back up ice and across the blue line.
4. After the shot, Player 1 turns to Player 3 and receives a pass.
5. Player 1 makes a long pass to Player 2.
6. Player 2 shoots.

Passing.name: NZ Timing & Support (seq. 2)
Passing.description: Use the same setup as sequence 1. After the first two-shot sequence, Player 2 picks up a puck in the corner and passes to either Player 1 or Player 3 for a third shot.

Passing.name: Offensive zone shooting drill with timing - 10 mins
Passing.description:
On the whistle, the blue player starts without a puck, skates towards the middle over the cone and receives a pass (pass 1) from the green player on the other side. Right after the pass the green player now skates towards the middle over the cone and heads to the net, while the blue player goes down and around the second cone and passes (pass 2) it back to the green player who goes in and shoots (shot 1) After the 2nd pass, the blue player continues back over the cone towards the line where they came from. Turning down around the middle cone (going towards the net) the blue player receives a pass (pass 3) from the line and goes in and shoots (shot 2)

Key Points: Timing. Remember to alternate lines.

Passing.name: Oilers Continuous Breakout
Passing.description: 1. The Coach starts the drill by dumping a puck in the corner. 2. The D retrieves the puck, and breaks out with the 1’s. 3. Bring the puck 5 on 0 to the neutral zone, then dump the puck in, and the 3's breakout, 5 on 0, from the other end. 4. 2's breakout next, then the 4's Use different breakouts each time. Quick up, D to D, D Reverse, D to C, D to W. Breakout from one end then the other. The drill only uses one puck.

Passing.name: One puck passing (follow your pass timing and awareness) - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts st c o t e ce a ds o t e st c eep eet o g ead up o a a e ess The first player in the start line skates toward the center ice circle... he receives the pass within the center ice circle and passes it straight across then follows the pass to that line. The initial passer now heads toward the the center ice circle and receives the puck and passes it straight across and follows the pass to that line. NOTE: Whoever passes from a stationary position located on the blue line walls... is next to go. You always go straight across diagonally and follow your pass. KeKey Points: Timing + passing accuracy, control + awareness, follow your pass.

Passing.name: One-Touch Timing
Passing.description: Designate a Passer for the ﬁrst time, just to start the drill. 1. First player from each line at one side of the ice leave together 2. Low man swings to receive the pass, then touch passes to his partner swinging through at mid-ice. 3. Receiver shoots, passer picks up a puck and passes to the low man of the other line 4. Drill is perpetual Note: this is a GREAT precursor to the 3-zone timing drill, found in Volume 1

Passing.name: OVER/UNDER
Passing.description: 49 KEY POINTS: • Timing • Driving lanes hard • Emphasis on jumping off the wall DESCRIPTION • On whistle, X1 passes to X4, drives to red line and stops • X1 receives pass from X4, jumps off wall, attacking the mid lane for a • shot on net- stops at net • At the same time, X2 skates blueline and pass- es back and forth with X 3. X3 holds puck. • X2 skates to wall and then up red line, cutting across to far dot • X3 receives a stretch pass from the opposite side, X3 and goes in for a shot on net

Passing.name: Partner Line Passing
Passing.description: Player skates and makes a pass then follows their pass.

Passing.name: Pass to D, delay for exchange (changing gears) - 10 mins
Passing.description: a d passes Players situated at all four blue line boards with 2 Defense men at the middle blue line. On the whistle the opposite adjacent players go... Pass to the Defense man in front of you then delay to get the return pass from the Defense man who was beside you. He gets his puck from the player coming from the other side. KeKey Points: D, rotate after 5, 6 reps and always be in motion when receiving and giving passes.

Passing.name: Passing around the world - 4 touch passes - 10 mins
Passing.description: Both ways (counter clockwise + clockwise) Leave without a puck Execute 4 touch passes end up back where you started 4 players go simultaneously KeKey Points: stick on the ice. 2 hands on the stick.keep feet moving. Head up for awareness

Passing.name: Passing Medley
Passing.description: 1. Player leaves corner and picks up pass from his line 2. After receiving the pass, he passes to P in the corner and gets it back 3. Executes give and go with P on the blue line, then shoots 4. Players rotate as shown

Passing.name: Passing shuttle - Follow your pass in a straight line Forward - 10 mins
Passing.description: Pass with feet moving Follow your pass Receive pass stationary KeKey Points: No Dusting the puck. Stick on the ice to set a target. Keep the puck on the front of the blade.

Passing.name: Passing shuttle with Traffic - Follow your Pass - 10 mins
Passing.description: Pass with your feet moving -> follow your pass Receive pass stationary KeKey Points: No Dusting the puck! Keep the puck on the front of the blade. Head up, look up for traffic and timing

Passing.name: Patrick Perpetual Breakout
Passing.description: 1. Passers start the drill by shooting then picking up a puck behind the net to initiate the breakout 2. Low forward simulates winger, and swings in to pick up board-side breakout pass 3. High forward swings through and acts as the centerman providing middle support 4. Winger one-touches to center, who attacks and shoots, then initiates breakout in far zone 5. Winger moves to middle line. Note: winger can swing from top down, or from bottom up, depending on your team's breakout set up.

Passing.name: Perpetual Breakout/Forecheck
Passing.description: 1. 5 defenders start in "5 card" formation 2. Coach dumps the puck in 3. 5 attackers forecheck using a speciﬁed forechecking system 4. 5 defenders play DZC until they are able to execute a breakout 5. After the defenders break out of the zone, the attackers are done and peel off to the bench 6. After breaking out, the defenders cross the center line, and dump the puck in for the 5 new defenders who have lined up in "5 card" formation 7 The 5 who dumped it in become the new

Passing.name: Perpetual Cycle
Passing.description: 1. Coach dumps a puck in - ﬁrst player goes into corner, picks up the puck, and cycles it 2. Second player follows & picks up the cycle. 3. After cycling it back, the ﬁrst player cuts across the top of the circle and drives the net - second player passes for a one-timer 4. After the pass is made, the next player in line dumps it in the other corner. 5. Player who just made the pass continues up around the top of the circle, then drives into the corner to pick up the dump. 6. He cycles back, and the player who dumped it in supports to pick up the cycle. Same thing happens again. 7. Drill continues perpetually.

Passing.name: Perpetual Pass w/Power Turns
Passing.description: 1. Run both sides at the same time 2. Drill starts with a “ghost man” (Gh) in each corner. After the ﬁrst rotation the Gh isn’t needed anymore 3. Players follow the sequence executing power turns and passes as shown 4. After the last turn, the outside man drives wide and shoots 5. Inside man starts the drill going the opposite direction as the wide man

Passing.name: Perpetual Regroup
Passing.description: 1. Players line up in each bench and go 3 at a time (extra defensemen on the bench too) 2. Forwards pass out to the defensemen, then execute a regroup with the ﬁrst set of defensemen, then another group with the second set of defensemen 3. After the second regroup, the forwards get off the ice, and the next set of forwards start the drill the other direction 4. This is designed to be a quick-paced drill, constantly rotating new forwards and defensemen in and out.

Passing.name: proper retrieval with puck protection up the wall - 10 mins
Passing.description:
c a ge o d ect o s u at o ) o a ds a ays s oot t e e d t ey sta t o This is a 2 part progression. Whistle generated. Players line up at both blue lines facing the net. Part
1. On the whistle... Players do an explosive 2-3 step start towards the net. Then skate into the corner on the side where the pucks are loosely placed for retrieval. The player retrieves the puck turning up ice, keeping it protected using the body as a shield. Once in control, gather speed through the neutral zone, over the blue line, drive wide (around the pre-set cones) and shoot. Part
2. 2 players leave on the whistle... The first player retrieves and the other goes across the blue line and sets a post up on the same side as the pucks. The retrieving player passes up to the posted up player on teh boards and follows teh pass the get a return give and go pass back. Both players then attack 2 on
0. KeKey Points: Quick start Shield the puck when retrieving 2 hands on the stick when retrieving

Passing.name: Quad Passing
Passing.description: 1. Players 1 and 2 execute ﬁve passes between themselves 2. After the ﬁfth pass, player 1 does a give and go with player 3, combined with a one- touch pass to player 4. 3. All players rotate as shown.

Passing.name: Quick touch passes quick feet around the center face off circle - 10 mins
Passing.description: g a d co t o speed 1 or 2 players (Option or progress) Line up by the cone/s On the whistle Receive a pass from the line (1 or 2 depending on the number of player/s at the comes) Exchange a puck stationary (touch passes) then immediately Skate around the center ice face off circle heading toward the other line. Exchange another touch pass again now in motion. Continue around and through the neutral zone and receive pass across the blue from original line you started from. KeKey Points: 1 or 2 players at a time can do this drill. Remember to switch sides. After the initial 1st touch pass, players should be at full speed while skating around the face off circle. Passes need to be quick and accurate. Sticks on the ice the whole time!

Passing.name: Rapid Fire Breakout
Passing.description: 1. Drill is to be done full speed. Defensemen don't move, just stand feeding breakout passes 2. First round is D to D to F to C. Center attacks. Forward stays for the next round. 3. Next round is D to D to F. Forward attacks. 4. Lines rotate as shown.

Passing.name: Retrieval with pivots give and go single shot - 10 mins
Passing.description: On the whistle opposite adjacent players go. Skate straight up and through the neutral zone... Retrieve a spotted puck placed just under the blue line... Pivot with the puck skating backwards to the middle the re-pivot and open up now skating forward and up ice. Pass the puck through the neutral to player at the front of the line across from where you started. Completing a give and go taking the puck in and shooting. (2 total passes) Next whistle... the next players go the other way. KeKey Points: Players need to spot pucks! Clean Pivots Pass in stride + Maintain momentum

Passing.name: Ring Breakout
Passing.description: 1. The purpose of this drill is to work on controlling the ring breakout. 2. Forward passes down to the D, then swings through to become the passing option on the far side 3. D rings it to the far-side winger, who touch passes to the other forward 4. Forward skates up around the cone, pivots, then attacks 1 on 0 5. After the far-side winger redirects the ring, he passes to the D, and the drill repeats in the opposite direction. Note: Run it half ice or full ice

Passing.name: Sequencial passing 1-2,2-3,3-4,4-5 and 5-1 etc - 10 mins
Passing.description:
ey o ts g pass g accu acy, co t o a a e ess, o o you pass 1 passes to 2, 2 passes to 3,3 passes to 4, and 4 passes to 5 and 5 passes to 1!- stationary-get to know players + their numbers. Progression: 1st - Stationary (get to know players + numbers) 2nd - Moving/motion within the zone 3rd - Moving around entire ice, while finding players and maintaining sequence. KeKey Points: communication, 3 forms:
1. Verbal/Calling out
2. Acoustical/tapping your stick
3. Eye contact/ Keeping head up.

Passing.name: shooting position specific timing with progressions - 10 mins
Passing.description:
A-(Part 1) On the whistle. The forward (blue) goes into the corner, retrieves a puck skates up the boards and passes (pass 1) it to the 'D' (red) continue up the wall and receives the puck back (pass 2) then walks off the wall over circle goes in and shoots. Alternate sides on each whistle. B-(Part 2) On the whistle. The forward goes into the corner and retrieves a puck skates up the boards with it and passes (pass 1) it to the 'D' The D then passes (pass 2) it 'D'-'D' to their partner along the blue line. The forward follows in support along the blue line and receives the puck (pass 3) back and turns down, goes in and shoots. After the shot, the defense men slide/shift across the blue line (re-position) to do the other side. C-(Part 3) On the whistle. The forward goes into the corner and retrieves a puck, skates up the boards with it and passes (pass 1) to the 'D'. The immediately goes in front of the net to set a screen. The 'D' then passes (pass 2) it D-D to their partner along the blue line who takes a shot through the screen. After the shot, the defense men slide/shift across the blue line (re-position) to do the other side.

Key Points: Alternate from side to side on the whistle and players remember to switch sides.

Passing.name: Spice Figure 8 Passing
Passing.description: 1. On the whistle, one F from each line diagonally across from each other goes. 2. Each F takes a few steps forward, then passes to the far D. 3. These defensemen make a few "D to D" passes, then hit the F as he power turns around the far cone. 4. After skating the ﬁgure 8 as shown in the diagram, F picks up the puck, splits the defensemen, and enters the zone for a shot on net.

Passing.name: Stationary Passing
Passing.description: Stationary Passing.

Passing.name: Swedish 5 Pass & Shot
Passing.description: 1. On whistle, ﬁrst player from each diagonal line leaves without a puck (only one line shown here to keep the diagram simple) 2. First player skates across the blue line, receives a pass from the second player of the opposite line, then touch-passes it back 3. After passing it back, he or she loops around the top of the center-ice circle, receives a pass from the same line he or she left from, then touch-passes it back 4. After the second touch pass, player loops out wide, opens up as an outlet pass, receives another pass from the same line he/she left from, and attacks 1 on 0

Passing.name: Synchronized Passing
Passing.description: 1. Players line up about 2 stick-lengths apart in corner 2. Players skate down the ice, passing back and forth (cushioning while receiving, sweeping while giving) 3. At the far end, players criss-cross (move the net forward if you need more room), and come back passing back and forth Notes: Encourage players to incorporate the weight transfer into their stride while giving and receiving the passes. Giving a proper "sweep" pass, will put the player in the right position to execute a proper "cushion" when the return

Passing.name: Touch passes, Drive wide, Trailer pass - 10 mins
Passing.description: pass a te e te g o e t e bo t s g a tate to t e et Whistle generated... F and D face to face... F skates backward, D skates forward up the wall and make 2-3 touch passes. F opens up go across the blue line to receive a pass from the D on the other side. F enters the O-zone driving wide and deep and makes a trailer pass to the supporting D following the play. F heads to the front of the net to screen/tip or deflect the D's shot. D-shot os low and hard KeKey Points: Timing and speed. Screen/tips+deflections

Passing.name: Touch/stretch pass warm-up with timing (whistle) - 10 mins
Passing.description: ey o ts g t tu s o qu c t a s t o s t st c o t e ce e p os e sta ts o t e st e Diagonal opposites go (this is whistle generated) On the whistle the players (player 1) skate toward the middle and head up toward the center ice red line turning towards the boards now heading back to line where they started from. (completing a 360) The 2nd player in that line passes a puck and gets it right back in a pass exchange. Player 1 continues to skate across the ice along the blue line and receives a pass from the line on the other side and passes that puck right back in another pass exchange. Player 1 then does a tight turn around the neutral zone face off dot heading back toward the initial line they started from staying on-side. Player 1 then receives a stretch pass from the other end from the player who did the 2nd exchange pass. Player 1 takes the puck skates in on net and shoots. The other diagonal opposite players go on the next whistle. Remember to alternate lines. KeKey Points: Keep stick blades on the ice. 2 hands on the stick at all times. Feet constantly moving to maintain speed!

Passing.name: Turk continuous shoot for your friend (pad pass) - 10 mins
Passing.description:
This is a continuous drill but starts on the whistle. A player sets up in middle close to the blue line to start. On the whistle the starting players skates toward the end boards (to the right side) and turn towards the boards (using the face off dot as a guide to skate around) Skate up ice and receive a pass from the line on that same side. The player (red) is the shooter... Now skates toward the middle heading out of the end zone and tight turns from the middle to the boards around the neutral zone face off dot then skates wide and shoots low far side. (Shooting for rebounds and pad passes) The passer (green) skates up the boards outside the blue goes around the face off dot and heads down the middle towards the net looking for a rebound. After a possible rebound play the green player continues the drill by skating to the other side getting a pass and doing the same pattern/route.

Key Points: Drill can be done at both ends simultaneously Timing with low hard shots. areness... everyone must be ready.

Passing.name: Two Shot Passing
Passing.description: 1 will move the puck to 2. 2 will go in and shoot. 1 will receive a puck from coach and 1 will shoot.

Passing.name: Two-Player Passing Flow
Passing.description: 1 will pass to coach. 1 and 2 will hook as shown. Coach will move the puck to 2. 2 will move the puck back to 1.

Passing.name: Vasby 2 on 0
Passing.description: 1. Drill starts on the whistle. One end, then the other. 2. F makes a pass to the opposite line. 3. Pass across the blue line. 4. A cross-ice return pass to the F's. 5. 2 on 0.

Passing.name: Vasby 2 on 1
Passing.description: 1. Drill starts on the whistle. One end, then the other. 2. F makes a pass to the opposite line. 3. Pass across the blue line. 4. A cross-ice return pass to the F's. 5. D steps out for a 2 on 1. Variation: 3 on 1- The player who makes the cross-ice pass joins for a 3 on 1 or a 3 on 2.

Passing.name: Wide Crossovers, Angle Shot
Passing.description: 1. First player skates a loop as shown 2. Receives pass from the other line, and shoots 1 on 0 3. Picks up a puck in the corner, and gets back in line 4. After making the pass, passer begins drill from the other side

Passing.name: Wiseman Drill
Passing.description: 1. On whistle, player 1 skates up around the cone, 2 skates the "S", 3 skates the circle 2. Coach passes to 1, who touch passes to either 2 or 3 3. Whichever player receives the pass becomes F1, the far-side forward becomes F2, and player 1 becomes F3 Notes: As players become better at executing the drill as explained above, have the coach use the wingers as passing options too. If a winger receives the breakout pass, the middle man must swing IN FRONT of the puck carrier to provide front-side support and become the

Games.name: 1 on 1 Gap Control
Games.description: 3 on 0, 3 on 1, 3 on 2 1. Forwards in one bench, Defensemen in the other 2. On whistle, 3 Forwards swing low and receive a breakout pass from the Coach, then attack 3 on 0 3. After a quick attack, the same 3 Forwards swing to present themselves again for a breakout, while a Defenseman closes the gap. 4. Coach initiates breakout and Forwards attack 3 on 1. 5. After the 3 on 1, the same Forwards will swing again, receive a third breakout pass, then attack 3 on 2. 1. D carries puck inside blue line, passes to F, then backs up playing a tight gap 2. F attacks 1 on 1 3. Whenever Coach blows the whistle, F executes a quick turn back, D keeps gap tight by mirroring F, then the 1 on 1 continues 4. Coach may blow the whistle as many times as he/she wants

Games.name: 1 on 1 Swedish Overspeed Drill (phase 1)
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, the F makes a pass to the D. 2. The F skates across the ice and receives a return pass. 3. The D follows up the ice. 4. The F skates around the centre ice circle and goes 1 on 1 with the D, who has closed the gap for the 1 on 1.

Games.name: 1 on 1 Swedish Overspeed Drill (phase 2)
Games.description: Double re-group: 1. After the F skates around the centre ice circle, the F makes a pass to the D, and turns to the boards. 2. The D makes a board pass and closes the gap in the neutral zone. The F turns back for a 1 on 1.

Games.name: 1 on 1, 2 on 1, 3 on 1, D Shot
Games.description: 1. D1 starts the drill with a shot on goal. 2. After the shot, D1 meets F1 in the corner for a 1 on 1. 3. After the 1 on 1, D1 meets F2 in the opposite corner for a 2 on 1. 4. F2 works with F1 who stays in front of the net. 5. After the 2 on 1, F3 skates in from the blue line to start a 3 on 1. F1 and F2 stay in front of the net for the 3 on 1. 6. After the 3 on 1, D2 takes a shot on goal with F1, F2, & F3 in front, trying to screen or deﬂect. 7. D1 tries to box out the forwards.

Games.name: 1 on 1, 2 on 2, 3 on 3
Games.description: 1. Set up players as shown. Low pairings start tight, right in the corner to force a battle along the boards, low Defensemen close to the Forwards, on one knee 2. On whistle, Coach designates a pairing by pointing with the stick 3. Designated pairing plays a 1 on 1 battle until the next whistle 4. On next whistle, Coach designates another pairing to go 5. The ﬁrst pairing stays in the play, play becomes a 2 on 2. 6. On the next whistle, the last pairing goes, with the ﬁrst two pairings staying in Play

Games.name: 2 on 1 Perpetual Backcheck
Games.description: 1. On whistle, two forwards leave from one end, with a backchecker chasing (designate a backchecker to start the drill) 2. Coach passes to either forward 3. Defenseman from far blue line steps out to play 2 on 1 with backchecker 4. After the attack, the backchecker swings to one side or the other, becoming one of the forwards on the next 2 on 1 5. The forward on the same side the backchecker swings to becomes the next backchecker 6. Drill repeats going the other direction

Games.name: 2 on 1 Side-by-Side
Games.description: 1. 2 on 1 on each net 2. White forwards are on the same team as the white defenseman, blue forwards are on the same team as the blue defenseman. 3. Players can pass the puck between the cones, but nobody can cross the cones 4. Winning team stays.

Games.name: 2 on 2 in the Box
Games.description: 1. 2 on 2 within the "box." 2. If a puck leaves the box, coach throws in a new one

Games.name: 2 on 2 with “Rover” Behind the Net
Games.description: 1. Players play 2 on 2, or 3 on 3, in front of the net. 2. The "rover" stays behind the net and is on whichever team has the puck. 3. If there's a turnover, the team with the puck must pass to the rover before they can try to score. 4. Players stay in front of the goal line, rover stays behind the goal line.

Games.name: 2 on 2, 3 on 3 Corner Game
Games.description: 1. 2 on 2 or 3 on 3 in the corner. 2. Players not playing surround the area to keep pucks in. 3. Keep shifts short, and after a while change rules and allow both teams to score on either goal.

Games.name: 2 shot transition drive wide pass to trailer set up for point shot - 10 mins
Games.description:
Whistle generated. On the whistle. The D (red) skates forward up off the wall from the blue and pivots to backward and skates back over the blue line. F1 (green) times his start ensuring the Dman is skating backward. Comes out of the center face off circle with a puck and passes (pass 1) it to the the D. F2 (blue) goes directly to the wall just over the center red line on the same side and posts up (stationary) with their stick on the ice (showing their forehand) The D steps up (starts skating forward) and passes (pass 2) the puck to F2 (blue) at the boards. F1 (green) turns up ice after his/her initial pass (pass 1) with timing and support, skating through the neutral zone towards the boards and F2. F2 (blue) chips/passes (pass 3) the puck to F1 (green) who receives the pass while collecting speed through the neutral zone. F1 (green) gains the offensive zone and "drives wide" with the puck. F2 (blue) gains the zone (staying onside) with F1 and goes into the middle staying high as the trailer. F1 (green) passes (pass 4) the puck up high to F1 (blue) who takes a shot (shot 1) with both F1 and F2 going the net/goalie for a rebound and to set up a screen. The D (red) follows up on the play/drill and stops just inside the blue line (on the same side as the coach), receives a pass (pass 5) from the coach out of the corner and take a point shot (shot 2) F1 and F2 play/ battle the goalie if any possible rebound.

Key Points: D – Step up/ skate forward when passing to the post up. (F2) F1 – drive wide and ss high to the trailer. Both forward go to the blue paint/crease area to set the screens. D – w powerful point shots

Games.name: 2 vs 2 Gap Drill
Games.description: 2 vs 2 as shown. Forwards hook around the cones. Coach will move a puck to F group. D will go at the same time maintaining gap and hook around the dot. 2 vs 2.

Games.name: 2vs2 Puck advancement with timing and transition - 10 mins
Games.description: The drill starts with the strong side D retrieving a puck near the center ice red line, pivoting with it and takeing it into the zone. With timing his partner in the drill hinges and sets up for a relief pass (D to D) F1 with timing, skates straight across under the blue line and receives a pass from the hinged D. F1 advances (passes) the puck to F2 who also timed his start heading up ice. Both forwards go down 2vs0 and shoots (with 1 pass maximum prior to the shot). After the shot both forwards regroup, receive pass from the coach and attack the 2 original D in the drill (who kept proper gaps) 2vs2 back the other way. Battle until a goal, the puck gets cleared out or a whistle.

Games.name: 2vs2 starts with 2 point shots - 10 mins
Games.description: One side starts on the whistle, Whichever side starts first, that forward passes the puck to D at the blue line, then goes to net and sets a screen. The forward on the other side does the same. The first D shoots through the one forward screen. With timing the second D shoots with both forwards in front of the net. After the second shot and a short battle in front of the net (if required). Both forwards then vacate and get a pass from the line, attack the 2 defense men 2vs2 going the other way into the other end. Battle until a goal, the puck gets cleared out or a whistle.

Games.name: 2vs2 with 2 shot start - 10 mins
Games.description:
Both D's retrieve a puck and pass to forwards breaking out near the hash marks along the boards. Both forwards go all the way down the ice and shoot, ensuring not to shoot at the same time. (giving the goalie ample time to set up for each shot. After the second shot, both forwards circle back, get puck from the coach and attack 2vs2 against the original D who are gapping the forwards in the drill. Battle until a goal, the puck gets cleared out of the zone or a whistle.

Key Points: Ensure proper D gaps after the break out passes also when setting up the 2vs2.

Games.name: 3 on 1 Keep-Away
Games.description:
1. Play 3-on-1 inside the circles using touch passes.
2. The player whose pass is intercepted becomes the defender in the middle.
3. Maintain constant movement.

Games.name: 3 on 3
Games.description: 3 on 3.

Games.name: 3 on 3 Controlled Keep-Away
Games.description:
1. Coach dumps the puck to either defenseman.
2. Defensemen and center play keep-away while executing mock breakouts; they cannot break out past the top of the circles.
3. Forecheckers execute the designated forecheck until they gain possession, then attack the net.
4. If possession takes too long, coach blows the whistle and resets.

Games.name: 3 on 3 Cross-Ice 2-Pass
Games.description:
1. Play 3-on-3 across the width of the ice.
2. After a turnover, the team must complete two passes before shooting.
3. Keep the pace high with quick rotations.
4. Players waiting can stay in the neutral zone.

Games.name: 3 on 3 D Support
Games.description:
1. Forwards battle 3-on-3 in the neutral zone but cannot cross the imaginary goal line.
2. If the puck crosses the goal line, the corresponding defenseman breaks it out; a new puck may be used to keep pace.
3. Forwards swing to get open. Opposing forwards may pressure the defenseman but cannot cross the line.
4. Defensemen cannot cross the line.

Games.name: 3 Puck Scoring Race
Games.description: 1. Coaches place 3 pucks on each blue line 2. Teams of 3 race each other to score the 3 pucks ﬁrst 3. All three players must clear the zone after each goal 4. Set up a tournament, winners player winners until a champion is declared

Games.name: 3 Shot Attack 2 on 1
Games.description: 1. O1 skates around ﬁrst cone, shoots and continues to front of net for screen or tip in from O2's shot. 2. After O2's shot, O1 then drifts to the back post for a possible pass from O3. 3. O2 skates around ﬁrst cone and tight turns the second cone for a point shot with O1's screen or tip in. 4. O3 skates around the outside of all 3 cones and either shoots, or passes to O1 on the back post. 5. After all 3 shots, O1 and O3 curl out of the zone and breakout against a now defensive O2 (who plays the 2 on 1)

Games.name: 3 shots from the point (screen_tips) - 10 mins
Games.description: p shots from the point (screen_tips) - 10 mins On the whistle, A forward (blue) skates out of the corner with a puck and passes (pass 1) to the same side D (red) then get to the front of the net and set a screen for the shot (shot 1) coming from that D. After the 1st and a short net front battle with the goalie, the same forward goes into the other corner to retrieve a puck, skate out of the corner and passes (pass 2) to that same side D, then get back in front of the net and set a screen for the shot (shot 2) coming from that D. after the 2nd shot and a short net front battle with the goalie, that same forward stays in front awaiting a 3rd shot from the middle D. With timing, a pass (pass 3) comes out from a predetermined corner for a 3rd point shot with the forward already setting a screen.

Games.name: 3 vs 3 Breakout Transition Game
Games.description: 3 vs 3. 12 total players. In this example O’s will be on offense. X must break the puck out to the Red X team. The Red X team will be in the neutral zone moving around and trying to catch the breakout pass from X. Red O must stay in the end zone and play defense. Once a group plays offense they will then switch to defense. Offensive group awaiting the breakout will always be in the neutral zone as where the defensive group will always be in the defensive zone. Defensive players must make a complete pass to the offensive group.

Games.name: 4 Blue Lines 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. D steps out and passes to F on the ﬂy. 2. F touch passes to the D in the other line. 3. D ﬁres pass across to forward in the other line, who touch passes back to the F swinging through. 4. The original D closes the gap and plays the 1 on 1

Games.name: 4 shots, D-retrievals (F's find seams and transiton) - 10 mins
Games.description:
On the whistle, the D starts in the corner and skates over top the face off circle facing up ice, then pivots to retrieve a spotted puck, 4 times. After retrieving, the D makes 3 passes, one at a time to each open forward. (the Forwards try to find and get into an open lane) The D (red) finds and passes (pass 1) to one of the open forwards. (The D can pass to any of the forwards, in this diagram the green forward gets the first pass) The forwards then go in and shoot and set a screen. The Forwards who do not get a pass must go back and tag the blue line, re-find/locate open lanes and regroup back to the D (to get their pass) if a pass is not received. (In this diagram the 2nd pass goes to the yellow forward) The yellow forward goes back in and shoots (shot 2) and sets a screen. This means the blue forward must re-tag the blue line find a lane to receive a pass (pass 3) from the D and goes in to shoot (shot 3) and sets a screen (3 forwards in front now) The D does a 4th retrieval then carries the puck all the down and takes a point shot (shot 4) through a triple screen. The forwards battle the goalie if there is a rebound.

Key Points: F's fill lanes and stay in lanes. F's go north south (tight turns when transitioning) s read and pass to the nearest and most open forward. F's must be facing the D to receive pass. Coaches can fill lanes with active sticks, making the forwards find openings.

Games.name: 5 on 4 Breakout, Regroup, Attack
Games.description: 1. Players line up as shown 2. Coach dumps puck into corner 3. Offensive team forechecks, defensive team breaks out 4. After the breakout, forecheckers peel off, breakout forwards swing through for a regroup with the coach 5. As forwards are regrouping, defensemen close the gap 6. Forwards attack 3 on 2

Games.name: Anaheim 2 on 1
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, the F makes a pass to the D 2. The D makes a return pass to the F 3. The F makes a pass to the second F 4. 2 on 1 back.

Games.name: Area Pass 2 vs 2
Games.description: Players gets the puck and dishes it to the other forward (backhand if right hand player on this diagram. Sending an area pass. This play will be a 2 vs 2. 2 forwards vs the Defensive player and back checker. Both sides will go at the same time.

Games.name: Back to Back 3 on 3
Games.description: 1. Teams score on the opposite net from where they are standing. 2. Start with puck in between the nets. 3. 3 players from each team leave from the line on the whistle.

Games.name: Bank Pass 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. Forwards start with pucks in opposite corners 2. Bank pass to coach for a give and go 3. D perform some agility skating, then pick up the forward for a 1 on 1. Note: works well with large groups because the middle is left open. Put enough D in the middle to run it quickly.

Games.name: Breakout Forecheck 3 on 2
Games.description: 1. Divide players into two teams. 2. Game starts with a 2 on 2 going in each zone (8 players total). 3. Coach dumps the puck in and they battle 2 on 2. 4. Once the defensive team gets it, the player with the puck can skate it out, or pass to the other side and follow up the play to create a 3 on 2. 5. After a 3 on 2 turnover, player who crossed over must backcheck hard to avoid a 3 on 1 the other way.

Games.name: Breakout, Regroup, Regroup, Attack
Games.description: 1. Coach dumps puck in to one end, forwards execute a breakout 2. After breakout, forwards perform a regroup with the far defensemen, then regroup with the ﬁrst set of defensemen (same ones they broke out with) 3. After second regroup, forwards and defensemen attack 3 on 2

Games.name: Burkart 2 on 2 Deﬂection
Games.description: 1. F passes to D then drives net 2. D to D pass and shot 3. F deﬂects, then stays in front 4. Other corner passes out to D then drives net 5. D to D pass and shot 6. Other F deﬂects 7. F's swing for a breakout pass then attack 2 on 2 8. After second shot, D's back up 2 on 2

Games.name: Burkart Regroup
Games.description: 1. F passes to D and swings 2. D to D pass, then pass back to the Forward 3. F receives pass, then executes another regroup with the other set of defensemen 4. F attacks 1 on 0 VARIATION: have the D play the 1 on 1

Games.name: Burkett 3 on 3
Games.description: 1. No Sticks 2. Forwards try to get to the net and knock a puck in with their hand 3. Defensemen try to stop them 4. Forwards must clear zone after each goal

Games.name: Center Line Boundary 2 on 1
Games.description: 1. Set up a 2 on 1 in each side. 2. Nobody can cross the center line. 3. When the defender gets the puck back, he/ she must pass the puck across the line to the forwards on the other side. 4. Start with 2 on 1, work up to 3 on 2.

Games.name: Coach Regroup 3 on 2
Games.description: 1. Co passes to D to start the drill 2. Both D back up, passing back and forth 3. F's swing through for a regroup 4. After the regroup, the forwards pass to the coach, and swing again. 5. D close the gap and defend 3 on 2 against the forwards

Games.name: Conﬁned Space Stickhandling
Games.description: Designate a conﬁned space players have to stay in. Work through a progression of "games" 1. Full speed "3 strides and power turn." Players must go full speed. Players must keep their heads up! 2. Keep away. Designate 2 players as "it." They have to take the puck off another player and keep it. 3. Every player has a puck and is trying to knock each other's puck out of the rectangle while keeping their own puck. Last man standing wins.

Games.name: Continuous Odd-Man Rushes
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, two F's go 2 on 1 with the D. 2. The F's shoot until they score or until the D breaks up the play and makes a pass to two new F's providing wall support. 3. A new D steps out to play the 2 on 1 the other way. 4. If the F’s score, the coach makes a pass to the next group. VARIATIONS: Use all different combinations. 1 on 1, 2 on 1, 2 on 2, and 3 on 2.

Games.name: Continuous with retrievals cross crease timing and positioning (one timers) - 10 mins
Games.description:
ns A player (green) sets up at the side of the net near the face off dot. A Whistle to start the drill. The blue player, starts with a puck, goes in from the blue line and shoots checking for a rebound, and plays it if necessary. Continue to the loose puck pile on the same side beside the net, retrieve a puck and pass it to the green player across the crease and stays there (stop and set up after the pass). The green player shoots. Both players can play any possible rebound. Right after the shot and rebound battle, the green player goes to the loose puck pile and retrieves a puck and passes it up to the next (green) player at the blue line, who come in, shoots and continues the drill from the other side. This drill is done out of both ends.

Key Points: Quick release! Stick blade on the ice for ONE Timers or redirect shots. Play any ssible rebounds.

Games.name: Controlled 5 on 5 Forecheck
Games.description: 1. 5-man forechecking unit starts in the neutral zone 2. 5-man breakout unit starts in defensive zone 3. Coach dumps puck in, breakout unit attempts to breakout, forechecking unit attacks 4. Controlled "scrimmage" using a designated forechecking set-up (coach blows play dead if anyone is out of position) 5. When breakout unit gets the puck out, coach dumps a new puck in, forechecking unit clears the zone and attacks again

Games.name: Corner Combat Drill
Games.description: 1. Place players as shown. 2. This will produce a wall of player to limit the movement of players within the corner. 3. The coach places puck within the corner. 4. On coaches whistle, one player on each side, moves into the corner at full speed. 5. Player that controls the puck and moves out of the corner wins. 6. Then send the next two players in to battle.

Games.name: Corner Rebound Activation
Games.description: 1. Players battle 1 on 1 until a shot on net 2. After a team gets a shot, he can activate another player by passing to next guy in line (player closest to boards) 3. Build up to 2 on 2

Games.name: Czech Race
Games.description: 1. Players line up at the blue lines on the boards 2. On the whistle, two players across from each other race to the puck 3. The player who gets to the puck ﬁrst shoots, other player backchecks 4. On the next whistle the other two players go the other way

Games.name: D Pressure Shooting - 3 on 2
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, F1 makes a pass to the D and goes to the net to screen/deﬂect. 2. The D walks across the blue line and takes a shot on the net. 3. Then F2 makes a pass to the D and goes to the net. 4. The D walks across the middle and takes a shot on the net. 5. F1 and F2 screen/deﬂect. 6. After the shot, F3 skates up the ice with a puck. The F's attack, 3 on 2.

Games.name: D Shot - 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, the F passes a puck to the D and goes to the net. 2. The D walks across the blue line and takes a shot on goal. 3. The F tries to deﬂect/screen, then receives a new puck for a 1 on 1 with the D. VARIATION: The F who makes the pass can join the rush for a 2 on 1.

Games.name: D Skate 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, the D skate to the centre ice circle and pivot to backwards. 2. As the D skate around the circle, the F’s skate a puck along the top of the circle, take a shot, and receive a pass from the coach. 3. The F goes 1 on 1 against the D.

Games.name: Double Give & Go 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. Forward steps out of corner and executes a give and go with ﬁrst Defenseman in line. 2. After receiving the pass back, Forward skates around the far cone, then executes a give and go with the next Defenseman in line. 3. After receiving the second give and go, Forward curls around the other cone, then plays a 1 on 1 with the ﬁrst Defenseman, who has followed him around the ﬁrst cone, then closed the gap to the inside of the second cone.

Games.name: Drill 10: 2 vs 2
Games.description: Explanation: Place bumper as shown to create separation. 1 will move the puck to 3. 1 and 3 will be on a team and will enter the zone. 2 and 4 are back checking and on defense. 2 and 4 must make a complete pass to coach out of the zone or skate it out. Players are not able to shoot it out!

Games.name: Drill 9: 2 vs 2
Games.description: Rich Mihelic - Hockey Drills Explanation: X vs O’s. On the whistle, players will start as shown. Coach will pass the puck to X player. X’s are trying to score. O is trying to retrieve the puck and pass it to coach. Keeping score.

Games.name: Drive Drill Race
Games.description: 1. Forward runs a give and go with the Passer 2. Defenseman can't leave until Forward has received the return pass 3. 1 on 1 to the net Notes: Passer (P) can control how much time to give the (D) by making the return pass earlier or later in the play.

Games.name: Flow Forecheck (part 1)
Games.description: 1. Coach passes out to strong-side Defenseman for a shot on goal (forwards deﬂect and rebound) 2. Coach passes out to Center in high slot for a shot on goal (wingers deﬂect and rebound) 3. Coach passes out to weak-side Defenseman, who is sneaking into the low slot for a shot on goal (forwards deﬂect and rebound) 4. After 3rd shot, weak-side Defenseman swings in behind the net and picks up a puck to initiate the breakout (see next diagram)

Games.name: Flow Forecheck (part 2)
Games.description: 5. After the 3rd shot, the forwards open up into breakout formation 6. Forwards execute a breakout, step over the center line, and dump it in. 7. The 5-man unit in the NZ attempts to break out of the far end, while forwards who dumped it in forecheck 8. Once the 5-man unit makes it out of the zone, they attack 5 on 0, then stay in the zone for the passes from the coach. 9. Forechecking unit is done, 5 new players come into the NZ

Games.name: Full Ice 3 on 2
Games.description: Defensemen: 1. Coach passes to the close Defenseman, D to D pass, and shot. 2. Coach rings a puck to the far blue line, both D shift, D to D pass, and shot. 3. Defensemen close the gap in the NZ and play the 3 on 2 Forwards: 1. F1 steps in and shoots, then peels off to the bottom of the circle. 2. F2 steps in, passes to F1, receives a return pass, and shoots, then peels off to the bottom of the other circle. 3. F3 steps in, passes to F1, who banks it off the boards to F2, who centers it back to F3 for a shot. 4. Forwards swing open, receive a pass from the coach, and attack 3 on 2.

Games.name: Full Ice Regroup 2 on 1
Games.description: Drill starts on the whistle. One end, then the other. 1. On the whistle, a defenseman makes a pass to the forward. 2. Long, cross-ice pass to the second forward 3. Quick back pass to the defenseman. 4. Defenseman makes a long pass to the opposite defensemen for a re-group. 5. 2 on 1 back.

Games.name: Full-ice Team Zone Scrimmage
Games.description: 1. Each team tries to work the puck zone to zone into the offensive zone and score. 2. Puck must be passed, no slap-ins or slap- outs. 3. No skipping zones!

Games.name: Give & Go 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. On the whistle, the Forward makes a pass to the Defenseman. 2. Return pass to the Forward. 3. The Forward carries the puck under the blue line for a 1 on 1 on the opposite side. 4. Defenseman manages the gap, and plays the 1 on 1 Variation: A second Forward joins the play as the ﬁrst Forward skates under the blue line.

Games.name: Give & Go Timing 1 on 1
Games.description: Both ends go at the same time 1. Defenseman steps out of the corner and receives pass from Forward. 2. After receiving the pass, the defenseman skates the circle with the puck. 3. Forward skates the center circle and receives a return pass from the defenseman, and plays the 1 on 1 with the defenseman from the other line 4. After making the pass, then defenseman closes the gap with the forward from the other line, and plays the 1 on 1

Games.name: MacDonald Forecheck (part 1)
Games.description: 1. On whistle, forecheckers take a lap around the center circle 2. As the forecheckers ﬁnish their lap, coach dumps the puck in 3. Forecheckers attack, 5-man unit breaks out (see next diagram)

Games.name: MacDonald Forecheck (part 2)
Games.description: 4. After the breakout occurs, puck is passed back to the coach 5. 2 of the 3 forwards peel out to take a lap around the middle circle, becoming the new forecheckers (forwards must communicate who goes!) 6. As forecheckers ﬁnish the turn, coach dumps the puck in for a breakout from the far end 7. New 5-man unit moves into the end that just broke out

Games.name: Man in the Box 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. Forward starts in corner with puck - one skate behind the line! 2. Defenseman starts in face-off circle with stick in the dot (as speed improves, move closer and closer) 3. On whistle, forward and defenseman race to the red line, staying on their own respective sides of the cone 4. The forward can't cut inside and the defenseman can't begin to angle until AFTER they've passed the cone 5. After the cone they can play a 1 on 1

Games.name: Man in the Box 2 on 1
Games.description: 1. Same as man in the Box 1 on 1, but add a forward to make it a 2 on 1

Games.name: Man in the Box 2 on 2
Games.description: 1. Forwards start in the corners, defensemen on the dots 2. On the whistle, the forwards and defensemen race straight to the red line 3. Forwards can't cut inside, and defensemen can't angle or pivot forward until AFTER the red line. 4. After the red line, forwards and defensemen play it like a regular 2 on 2.

Games.name: Michigan Tech 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. On whistle, 2 forwards and 2 defensemen leave 2. Defensemen do a ﬁgure 8 around the cones, then make a breakout pass to the forward swinging through from the far end 3. After making the pass, defensemen close the gap on the forward who left from their same side 4. If coach blows the whistle twice, the forwards change direction and play the 1 on 1 with the other defensemen 5. Coach can blow the whistle multiple times during the same turn. Defensemen must continue to close the gap with each switch.

Games.name: Multiple elements 3 shots D- retrievals - 10 mins
Games.description:
On the whistle F1 (blue) skates out of the corner with a puck, stays low and takes a hard angle shot (shot 1). F2 (green) with timing passes (pass 1) the puck to the D (red) at the point, then goes to the front of the net to set a screen. The D (red) shoots (shot 2) through the screen, from the point. After the point shot, the D, F1 and F2 vacate the zone. The D goes all the way back to retrieve a spotted puck (from the coach), turning up ice into the middle with the puck and passes (pass 2) it to F1 (blue), who with timing comes up through the middle, swinging above the center ice red line, going wide towards the boards. F1 (blue) receives the pass at the boards and directly passes or can indirect chip pass (pass 3) it to F2 (green). F2 (green) who has also with timing comes up through the middle, swinging under the center ice red line, going wide towards the boards supporting the pass (pass 3) from F1. Now with the puck, F2 (green) gains the zone drives wide with the puck delaying, waiting for F1 (blue) to join the attack with the D (red) in HOT pursuit, back checking, turning the 2vs0 into a 2 on
1. Battle until a goal, the puck is cleared, or a whistle.

Games.name: Multiple elements Game situation team challenge bag skate - 10 mins
Games.description:
On the whistle 5 players are in the drill, 3 forwards come out of the corner skate behind the net, receive a pass (pass 1) from the coach and attack 2 defense men 3 on
2. The 2 Defense men leave at the same time from the blue line boards maintaining gap, tracking the forwards ready to defend a 3 on
2. Battle 3 on 2 until a 2nd whistle initiates a back check simulation, all players go back up along the boards, the same side they came out from. 2 of the forwards go all the way back behind the net, receive a pass (pass 2) from the coach with 1 of the defense men tracking, maintaining gap on those 2 forwards ready to defend a 2 on
1. 1 of the forwards goes back and across blue line, receives a pass (Pass 3) or a spotted puck from the coach, with 1 of the defense men tracking, maintaining gap ready to defend a 1 on
1. Key Points: Be aware of the timing between the 1 on 1 and 2 on
1. The 1 on 1 has to be a net ve and clear out quickly. The 2 on 1 is coming right behind the 1 on 1.

Games.name: Multiple elements timing and positioning - 10 mins
Games.description:
On the whistle, D1 (red) starts backwards along the boards and does a one touch pass exchange with D2. D2 soft dumps the puck into the same side corner for D1 to retrieve. At the same time F1 (blue) leaves and skates along the blue line into the middle and receives a pass (pass 1) from F2 (green) F1 goes in and takes a shot (shot 1). With timing D1 retrieves the puck and skates it behind the net over to the other side, After F1 shoots, go deep into the corner heading up ice simulating a break out and receives a pass (pass 2) from D1. F2 (green) after the whistle to start the drill, with timing skates to the middle into the zone supporting F1 on the same side and receives a pass (pass 3) and skates the puck out of the zone. 2 Defencemen awaiting and are gaping through the neutral zone and receive a pass (pass 4) from F2 (green) they pass (pass 5) D-D F1 and F2 on the way out of the zone receive a pass (pass 6) back from the D's and turn back and attack against the original D who retrieved the puck (gaping the forwards) and a new D who with timing, steps in off the boards to join the drill making it a 2 vs
2. After the sequence and a short battle, clear the zone, then the other side goes.

Key Points: Timing. Accurate passing. Forwards should try to stay inside the dot line.

Games.name: Net-Front Battles
Games.description:
1. Play 2-on-2 in front of the net.
2. Coach feeds the puck back to a defenseman for a shot.
3. Play stays live until the forwards score, defenders clear the puck to the corner, or the goalie freezes it.
4. The team that wins the battle earns a point. First to five wins.
5. Keep the drill quick-paced.

Games.name: Nets Back to Back 3 on 3
Games.description: Nets back to back 3 on 3.

Games.name: NZ 4 on 4 2-Pass
Games.description:
1. Play 4-on-4 in the neutral zone.
2. Players must complete at least two passes before shooting.
3. Progression: players cannot hold the puck; all passes must be touch passes.

Games.name: On the Dot 3 on 2
Games.description: 1. 2 on 2 plus 1. Players on dots can pass or shoot, but can't leave the dots. 2. Make it 3 on 3 plus 1 after a while Note: With certain teams the drill may run better by letting the "dot men" move anywhere within their half, so it becomes a true 3 on 2 in each zone (notice added cones)

Games.name: Perpetual Backcheck
Games.description:
1. First player in each line leaves and receives a pass from the coach.
2. Each player skates full speed down the ice and takes a shot.
3. The next player cannot leave until the shot is taken.
4. After shooting, the shooter peels off and backchecks the next player.
5. Continue perpetually.

Games.name: Perpetual Breakout/Forecheck
Games.description: 1. 5 defenders start in "5 card" formation 2. Coach dumps the puck in 3. 5 attackers forecheck using a speciﬁed forechecking system 4. 5 defenders play DZC until they are able to execute a breakout 5. After the defenders break out of the zone, attackers peel off to the bench 6. After breaking out, the defenders cross the center line, and dump the puck in for the 5 new defenders who have lined up in "5 card" formation 7. The 5 who dumped it in become the new forecheckers

Games.name: Puck Protection in the Circles
Games.description: 1. Two players with sticks try to keep the puck inside the circle 2. Two other players without sticks are trying to get the puck outside of the circle 3. Two extra players are waiting outside the circle for rotations 4. No holding or wrestling!

Games.name: Regroup 2 on 0, 2 on 2
Games.description: 1. Forwards make a pass to the defensemen, then regroup and attack 2 on 0 2. After the 2 on 0 attack, both forwards swing open and receive a breakout pass from the coach 3. Defensemen close the gap, and forwards breakout 2 on 2 4. Run both sides simultaneously to force heads up play in the neutral zone.

Games.name: Regroup, Shot, 2 on 1
Games.description: 1. Forwards start in corners at the hash marks, with Defensemen in the center circle 2. On whistle, defenseman swings down and picks up a puck from the dot and makes a stretch pass to the forward on that side 3. Forward attacks 1 on 1, then swings to the boards for a "criss-cross" pass from the other forward 4. Defenseman closes gap, and forwards attack 2 on 1 5. Run from both sides simultaneously.

Games.name: Relay Race
Games.description: Relay race.

Games.name: Spice Gap Control
Games.description: 1. On whistle, the ﬁrst forward from each line skates full speed around the cones, and attacks 1 on 1 2. Defensemen in the middle need to read the speed of the forward, close the gap, and manage the 1 on 1

Games.name: Spice Rebound Activation
Games.description: 1. One player from each team starts on the dots across from each other 2. Coach dumps puck in for a 1 on 1 battle. 3. As soon as a player gets a shot on net, another man from his team may be activated. 4. Player must pass back to next man in line in order to activate the player. 5. Activate up to 3 players - play continues until a goal is scored. Variation: Try this full ice -- start with 3 on 3 then activate up to 5 players.

Games.name: Square 1 on 1
Games.description: 1. D2 takes a few steps and passes to F1 on the ﬂy, then loops around the middle cone to play the 1 on 1. 2. He will then tip the pass to D2 who passes to F2. 3. F2 gives it back to F1 who attacks 1 on 1 4. Both sides run at the same time.

Games.name: Tennis Ball Hockey
Games.description: Tennis Ball Hockey.

Games.name: Tennis Ball Shootout Challenge
Games.description: Player shoots then plays goalie for the following player.

Games.name: Tic Tac Toe
Games.description: Tic Tac Toe.

Games.name: Tom Renney Warm-up
Games.description: Both sides go at the same time. After the dump in and breakout, both defensemen play 2 on 1 against the other line's forwards. 1. Two forwards swing low and receive a pass from the coach, then step over the center line and dump it in. 2. Goalie stops the puck for the defenseman, who initiates the breakout, then plays 2 on 1 against forwards from the other line. 3. Forwards attack 2 on 1 against the defenseman from the other line

Games.name: Triangle One-Timer
Games.description: 1. Players are conﬁned within the lines of their areas. 2. Focus on quick puck movement. 3. Touch passes and One-timers.

Games.name: War
Games.description: Players have a line they cannot cross and they try to shoot it over to the opposite side. Whoever clears the most pucks wins!
